title.en: World Desk
title.zh: 全球焦点

strap.en: A fast view of global affairs, conflict, diplomacy, and human need.
strap.zh: 快速掌握国际局势、冲突、外交与人类处境。

title.en: Farage faces questions over his claim of facing second standards investigation
title.zh: 法拉奇面临对其面临第二次标准调查的质疑

summary.en: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage is facing scrutiny over his claim that his finances were under a second investigation by the standards watchdog, as he was sworn in as the MP for Clacton. The watchdog is not believed to have decided to open a second inquiry.
summary.zh: 英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）在再次宣誓就任克拉克顿议员之际，正面临对其声称其财务状况受到标准监察机构第二次调查的质疑。据信，监察机构尚未决定是否展开第二次调查。

body.en: Reform leader said inquiry had been widened but watchdog is not believed to have decided whether to do so Nigel Farage is facing questions about why he claimed his finances were the subject of a second standards investigation, as he was sworn in again as Clacton’s MP. The Reform UK leader said when he resigned in July that the standards system had become a “political tool” because “yet another standards investigation is under way” into his finances. Continue reading...
body.zh: 改革领袖表示，调查范围已经扩大，但据信监管机构尚未决定是否这样做。奈杰尔·法拉奇在再次宣誓就任克拉克顿议员时，面临着为何声称自己的财务状况受到第二次标准调查的质疑。这位改革英国领导人在七月份辞职时表示，标准体系已经成为一种“政治工具”，因为“另一项标准调查正在进行中”，针对他的财务状况。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Public life demands integrity and accountability. When leaders make claims about investigations, the public has a right to clarity and truth. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true leadership involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God, principles that should guide all public servants.
reflection.zh: 公众生活需要正直和问责。当领导人就调查发表声明时，公众有权获得清晰和真相。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的领导力在于秉公行义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑与雅伟同行，这些原则应指导所有公职人员。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Burnham promises to bring optimism and ‘substantial change’ in first Commons speech as PM
title.zh: 伯纳姆承诺在上任首相的首次下议院演讲中带来乐观和“实质性变革”

summary.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham, in his first speech to the Commons since taking office, pledged to foster optimism and implement 'substantial change.' He acknowledged the UK's past 'wrong turns' over the last 40 years, attributing a decade of low growth to factors like Brexit and the legacy of Margaret Thatcher. Burnham...
summary.zh: 首相安迪·伯纳姆自上任以来首次在下议院发表演讲，承诺将带来乐观和“实质性变革”。他承认英国在过去40年里走过了一系列“弯路”，并将脱欧和撒切尔夫人的遗产归咎于过去十年的低增长。伯纳姆的目标是让未来十年比过去十年更好，并暗示承诺到2030年将国防开支提高到国内生产总值的3%。

body.en: The prime minister said Britain needed to be brutally honest about the ‘series of wrong turns’ it had taken in the last 40 years Andy Burnham has blamed Brexit and Margaret Thatcher for a decade of low growth in the UK, arguing that Britain needs to be brutally honest about having taken “a series of wrong turns” in the last 40 years. In his first Commons appearance since he took over as prime minister around six weeks ago, Burnham told MPs he wanted to build a new sense of optimism so “we can make this next decade better than the last”. Hinted that he would commit to spending 3% of GDP on defence by 2030, saying he had appointed John Healey as his chancellor “precisely because” of his position on military spending . Opened the door to looking again at electoral reform in Labour’s next manifesto. “I do believe there needs to be a mandate to make that change. There are different views in this house, but I believe we will need to get a consensus at the next election. And if there is that consensus, then a change can be made in the next parliament.” Announced he would attend the Cop31 climate summit in Turkey and continue pursuing green energy – but that he would be “pragmatic” on supply, amid expectations he will approve the Jackdaw gas field. “The mistake is saying it’s got to be one or the other for political purposes. The truth is, it’s going to have to be both.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 首相表示，英国需要对过去 40 年来所采取的“一系列错误转变”坦诚相待。安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 将英国十年来的低增长归咎于英国脱欧和玛格丽特·撒切尔，认为英国需要对过去 40 年来所采取的“一系列错误转变”坦诚相待。伯纳姆自大约六周前就任总理以来首次在下议院露面，他告诉国会议员，他希望建立一种新的乐观情绪，以便“我们可以让下一个十年比上一个十年更好”。暗示他将承诺到2030年将GDP的3%用于国防，并称他任命约翰·希利为总理“正是因为”他在军费开支上的立场。为工党下一份宣言中重新审视选举改革打开了大门。 “我确实认为需要授权来进行这种改变。众议院有不同的观点，但我相信我们需要在下次选举中达成共识。如果达成共识，那么可以在下届议会中做出改变。”宣布他将参加在土耳其举行的第 31 届缔约方会议气候峰会，并继续追求绿色能源，但他在供应方面将采取“务实”态度，因为人们预计他将批准寒鸦气田建设。 “错误在于出于政治目的说必须是其中之一。事实是，两者都必须是。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In his inaugural address, Prime Minister Burnham spoke of honesty regarding past national 'wrong turns' and a desire to build a new decade of optimism. This echoes the ancient call for leaders to govern with justice and righteousness, ensuring the well-being of the people. May his tenure be marked by a commitment to these enduring principles, seeking the...
reflection.zh: 在其就职演说中，伯纳姆首相谈到了对国家过去“弯路”的坦诚，以及建立一个充满乐观的新十年的愿望。这呼应了古老的要求，即领导者应以公正和正直来治理，确保所有人民的福祉。愿他的任期以致力于这些持久的原则为标志，寻求所有公民的福祉。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Briton among 119 more people rescued in Nepal after flash floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔山洪灾害中获救的119人中有一名英国人

summary.en: A British national was among 119 people rescued in Nepal on Tuesday, nearly a week after deadly flash floods triggered by a glacial collapse on the country's border with Tibet. Over 1,000 people have been confirmed dead, with more than 4,000 still missing.
summary.zh: 周二，在尼泊尔边境发生由冰川崩塌引发的致命山洪近一周后，一名英国公民与其他118人一同获救。此次灾难已造成超过1000人确认死亡，另有超过4000人失踪。

body.en: More than 1,000 people confirmed dead and more than 4,000 still missing in disaster triggered by glacial collapse A British national was among 119 people rescued in Nepal on Tuesday, an official said almost a week after deadly flash floods on the country’s border with Tibet. An army spokesperson told reporters at a press conference that Tuesday’s rescue efforts had saved 118 Nepali nationals – 44 women and 74 men. Continue reading...
body.zh: 冰川崩塌引发的灾难已确认超过 1,000 人死亡，仍有 4,000 多人失踪。一位官员表示，尼泊尔与西藏边境发生致命山洪爆发近一周后，周二在尼泊尔获救的 119 人中包括一名英国公民。一名军方发言人在新闻发布会上告诉记者，周二的救援行动已拯救了 118 名尼泊尔国民，其中包括 44 名女性和 74 名男性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal, where over a thousand lives have been lost and thousands more are missing, a glimmer of hope emerges with the rescue of 119 individuals. This act of salvation, bringing people out of peril, reflects the profound truth that in caring for the vulnerable and those in distress, we are serving Christ himself. May this...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水灾难中，已有千余人丧生，数千人失踪，但有119人的获救带来了希望的曙光。这次救援行动，将人们从危险中解救出来，体现了照顾弱者和困境中之人的深刻真理——我们在服侍他们时，也是在服侍基督。愿这次救援能激励人们继续援助受这场灾难影响的人们。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Todd Haynes and Wallace Shawn among signatories of letter backing Mark Ruffalo amid antisemitism charge
title.zh: 托德·海恩斯和华莱士·肖恩等签署信函，支持马克·鲁法洛免受反犹主义指控

summary.en: Over 170 Jewish artists, including Todd Haynes, Joel Coen, Miranda July, and Wallace Shawn, have signed an open letter supporting actor Mark Ruffalo. Ruffalo faced accusations of invoking antisemitic tropes after criticizing Paramount Skydance, a media company owned by David Ellison, an ally of Donald Trump. The actor...
summary.zh: 包括托德·海恩斯、乔尔·科恩、米兰达·裘莱和华莱士·肖恩在内的170多位犹太艺术家签署了一封公开信，支持演员马克·鲁法洛。鲁法洛在批评了唐纳德·特朗普盟友大卫·埃里森拥有的媒体公司派拉蒙天空舞（Paramount Skydance）后，面临被指控援引反犹主义的陈词滥调。这位演员曾就一项重大的合并交易发表过看法。

body.en: More than 170 Jewish artists, also including Joel Coen, Hannah Einbinder and Miranda July, have supported the actor after he criticized Paramount A collective of more than 170 prominent Jewish artists and academics – including Todd Haynes , Joel Coen , Miranda July , Hannah Einbinder , Wallace Shawn and Naomi Klein – have signed an open letter supporting Mark Ruffalo . The actor had been accused of invoking antisemitic tropes after he criticized Paramount Skydance, the media company owned by David Ellison, a Donald Trump ally. Ruffalo had spoken out about the $111bn merger with Warner Bros Discovery (WBD). Continue reading...
body.zh: 在马克·鲁法洛批评派拉蒙之后，包括乔尔·科恩、汉娜·艾因宾德和米兰达·朱莉在内的 170 多名犹太艺术家纷纷支持马克·鲁法洛。包括托德·海恩斯、乔尔·科恩、米兰达·朱莉、汉娜·艾因宾德、华莱士·肖恩和娜奥米·克莱因在内的 170 多名著名犹太艺术家集体签署了一封支持马克·鲁法洛的公开信。这位演员在批评唐纳德·特朗普盟友大卫·埃里森拥有的媒体公司派拉蒙 Skydance 后被指控援引反犹太主义比喻。鲁法洛曾公开谈论与华纳兄弟探索公司 (WBD) 价值 1,110 亿美元的合并案。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In public discourse, accusations can fly quickly, and it is easy for a narrative to solidify without all sides being fully heard. This letter, signed by many Jewish artists, seeks to offer a different perspective on Mark Ruffalo's comments, reminding us of the importance of considering multiple viewpoints before judgment. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this,...
reflection.zh: 在公共讨论中，指控可能迅速传开，叙事很容易在未充分听取各方意见的情况下就固定下来。这封由众多犹太艺术家签署的信函，试图为马克·鲁法洛的言论提供不同的视角，提醒我们在评判之前考虑多方观点的必要性。《箴言》18:17对此有所提及：“先说话的似乎有理，直到别人来辩论，才显出真相。”

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: ‘Dangerous power grab’: top Democrats decry USPS system that could thwart mail-in voting – live
title.zh: “开始认真对待”：卡尼在关税谈判陷入僵局之际回击美国官员——直播

summary.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney is responding to US officials who are blaming Canada for a trade war, with one US official stating that trade tension with Canada is 'more their emergency than ours.' Meanwhile, Democratic senator Chuck Schumer is introducing a bill to reverse recent US tariffs on Canadian goods, aiming to...
summary.zh: 总理马克·卡尼正在回应那些指责加拿大挑起贸易战的美国官员，其中一位美国官员表示，与加拿大的贸易紧张局势“是他们的紧急情况，而非我们的”。与此同时，民主党参议员查克·舒默正在提出一项法案，以撤销美国近期对加拿大商品征收的关税，旨在解决可负担性危机。

body.en: A Democratic senator disclosed a whistleblower statement, which warned of potential chaos as the USPS is set to launch a computer system that could derail mail-in voting Sign up for the US Breaking News email Democratic senator Chuck Schumer is introducing a bill that would reverse Donald Trump’s most recent tariffs, among them the new 50% duty on Canadian goods, MS Now reported . While the Senate minority leader’s proposed legislation has virtually no chance of becoming law, Schumer hopes that his proposal shows that Democrats are actively fighting the affordability crisis. Schumer first shared his proposed legislation with MS Now. Continue reading...
body.zh: 马克·卡尼总理回应美国官员指责加拿大发动贸易战的言论；据 MS Now 报道，杰米森·格里尔 (Jamieson Greer) 表示，与加拿大的贸易紧张局势“比我们更紧急”。 据 MS Now 报道，民主党参议员查克·舒默 (Chuck Schumer) 正在提出一项法案，该法案将扭转唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 最近的关税，其中包括对加拿大商品征收 50% 的新关税。虽然参议院少数党领袖提出的立法几乎没有机会成为法律，但舒默希望他的提案表明民主党正在积极应对负担能力危机。舒默首先与 MS Now 分享了他提议的立法。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Trade negotiations between Canada and the United States have stalled, leading to escalating tensions and sharp words. The principle of pursuing peace, even amidst disagreement, calls for a different approach than escalating rhetoric. May leaders seek wisdom and a spirit of reconciliation to find common ground and resolve these disputes constructively.
reflection.zh: 加拿大和美国之间的贸易谈判陷入僵局，导致紧张局势升级和言语交锋。在分歧中仍要追求和平的原则，要求采取不同于升级言辞的方式。愿领导人寻求智慧与和解的精神，以建设性地找到共同点并解决这些争端。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Ex-gang boss guilty of orchestrating 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
title.zh: 说唱歌手图帕克·沙库尔1996年谋杀案前团伙头目被判有罪

summary.en: Duane "Keffe D" Davis has been convicted of orchestrating the murder of rap superstar Tupac Shakur in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas in 1996. The conviction comes nearly 30 years after the event and marks the first conviction in this high-profile cold case.
summary.zh: 杜安（Duane "Keffe D" Davis）因策划1996年拉斯维加斯的一场驾车枪击案导致说唱巨星图帕克·沙库尔（Tupac Shakur）死亡而被定罪。此次定罪发生在事件发生近30年后，是这起备受瞩目的悬案首次定罪。

body.en:
Former gang boss Duane "Keffe D" Davis has been found guilty of orchestrating the murder of Tupac Shakur - the first conviction in a cold case that has intrigued hip-hop fans for nearly 30 years.

The jury found him guilty of one count of murder with a deadly weapon for the rap superstar's death in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on 7 September 1996.

Dressed in a black suit, the 63-year-old stood impassively in the Las Vegas court as the verdict was read, before saying he would appeal.

During the trial, the court heard a recording of a police interview in 2008 in which Davis said he was in the car from which shots were fired, but did not himself fire the bullets that killed Shakur.

Prosecutors argued that although Davis, a former leader of the South Side Compton Crips street gang, did not himself fire the gun, he ordered the shooting and supplied the gun that his nephew Orlando Anderson used to open fire.

Anderson died in an unrelated shooting in 1998, having denied involvement in the killing of Shakur.

As the verdict was read out on Monday, Shakur's relatives held hands, some hugging and crying.

Shakur was 25 when he was slain at the height of his career as one of rap's most influential voices. He has sold more than 75 million records worldwide.

For 30 years, the case remained one of America's most famous cold cases, spurring countless conspiracies - but never a conviction, until now.

During the trial, prosecutors said Davis had planned the shooting as retaliation after Anderson was involved in a fight with Shakur and his crew in Las Vegas just hours earlier.

Shakur's murder happened at a time of intense rivalry between the East Coast and West Coast rap scene and amid gang feuds between the Bloods and Crips, which had deep roots within hip-hop at the time.

His family appeared emotional in court, his sister embracing a prosecutor after the verdict was read while others sat crying nearby.

The key evidence in the case were Davis' own words, in which he repeatedly and publicly acknowledged being inside the white Cadillac from where the deadly shots were fired.

He had told authorities about his role in Shakur's death during a secret 2008 police interview related to the death of fellow rapper Notorious B.I.G., real name Christopher Wallace.

But his book and media interviews voided a protective agreement he had established with authorities that had blocked any criminal charges being filed, with the court ruling his police interview could be used in the murder trial against him.

In closing arguments, prosecutor Binu Palal told jurors to take Davis at his word and find him guilty.

For years, he argued, Davis had been telling people "that he is responsible for Tupac Shakur's murder" through documentaries, his memoir, podcasts and a police...
body.zh: 前黑帮老大杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯 (Duane "Keffe D" Davis) 因策划谋杀图帕克·沙库尔 (Tupac Shakur) 被判有罪，这是近 30 年来引起嘻哈迷关注的悬案中的首次定罪。 陪审团裁定他犯有一项使用致命武器谋杀罪，导致这位说唱巨星于 1996 年 9 月 7 日在拉斯维加斯发生的驾车枪击事件中死亡。 宣读判决时，这位 63 岁的男子身着黑色西装，面无表情地站在拉斯维加斯法庭上，然后表示将上诉。 在审判期间，法庭听取了 2008 年警方采访的录音，戴维斯称他当时就在开枪的车里，但他本人并没有开枪杀死沙库尔。 检察官辩称，虽然南区康普顿克里普斯街头帮派的前头目戴维斯本人没有开枪，但他下令开枪，并提供了他的侄子奥兰多·安德森用来开枪的枪。 安德森于 1998 年死于一场无关的枪击事件，他否认参与杀害沙库尔。 周一宣读判决时，沙库尔的亲属手拉着手，有些人拥抱哭泣。 沙库尔 (Shakur) 被杀时年仅 25 岁，他是说唱界最具影响力的声音之一，正值他职业生涯的巅峰时期。他在全球已售出超过 7500 万张唱片。 三十年来，此案一直是美国最著名的悬案之一，引发了无数阴谋，但直到现在才被定罪。 在审判期间，检察官表示，戴维斯计划开枪是为了报复安德森几个小时前在拉斯维加斯与沙库尔及其团队发生的打架事件。 沙库尔的谋杀案发生在东海岸和西海岸说唱界之间激烈竞争的时期，以及 Bloods 和 Crips 之间的帮派争斗之中，这些争斗在当时的嘻哈音乐中根深蒂固。 他的家人在法庭上显得情绪激动，宣读判决后，他的妹妹拥抱了一名检察官，而其他人则坐在附近哭泣。 该案的关键证据是戴维斯自己的话，他在其中多次公开承认自己在开枪的白色凯迪拉克车内。 2008 年，警方秘密约谈时，他曾向当局讲述了自己在 Shakur 之死中所扮演的角色，该约谈涉及说唱歌手 Notorious B.I.G.（真名 Christopher Wallace）的死亡。 但他的书和媒体采访使他与当局达成的保护协议无效，该协议阻止了任何刑事指控，法院裁定他的警方采访可以用于针对他的谋杀案审判。 在结案陈词中，检察官比努·帕拉尔告诉陪审员相信戴维斯的话并判定他有罪。 他认为，多年来，戴维斯一直通过纪录片、他的回忆录、播客和警方告诉人们“他对图帕克·沙库尔的谋杀负有责任”……

reflection.en: The conviction of Duane Davis for the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur brings a measure of closure to a case that has captivated the public for decades. It serves as a stark reminder that violence begets violence, and the consequences of such actions can echo through generations, ensnaring individuals in a cycle that ultimately leads to judgment. "Put your sword...
reflection.zh: 杜安·戴维斯因1996年图帕克·沙库尔谋杀案被定罪，为这起几十年来一直吸引公众关注的案件带来了一丝了结。它也警示我们，暴力会滋生暴力，此类行为的后果可能会影响几代人，使个人陷入最终导致审判的循环。“把你的剑收回原处吧，”耶稣对彼得说，“凡动刀的，必死在刀下。”（马太福音 26:52）。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: As Michigan Senate race heats up, Vance calls El-Sayed 'evil'
title.zh: 随着密歇根州参议员竞选升温，万斯称埃尔-赛义德‘邪恶’

summary.en: As the Michigan Senate race intensifies, JD Vance has entered the fray, labeling Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed as 'evil' in support of Trump ally Mike Rogers. The contest is marked by personal attacks, with El-Sayed also accusing the Trump administration of 'evil' policies.
summary.zh: 随着密歇根州参议员竞选日趋激烈，JD万斯加入战局，在支持特朗普盟友迈克·罗杰斯时，称民主党候选人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德为“邪恶”。竞选活动充斥着人身攻击，埃尔-赛义德也指责特朗普政府推行“邪恶”政策。

body.en:
US Vice-President JD Vance has waded into Michigan's bitter senate race, calling Democratic newcomer Abdul El-Sayed "evil" as he backs Trump ally Mike Rogers in the closely-fought contest.

At an event to support Rogers, Vance also warned El-Sayed to "keep my wife's name the hell out of your mouth", after the candidate appeared to suggest that Vance's late grandfather would not accept Second Lady Usha Vance, who is Hindu.

El-Sayed hit back at Vance later on Monday, accusing the Trump administration of pushing "evil" policies and of "starting wars abroad when there's peace".

Recent polling suggests he holds a narrow lead over Rogers in the key battleground state.

Speaking at a rally for Rogers in a Detroit suburb on Monday night, Vance repeatedly accused El-Sayed - who is Muslim - of being a divisive figure with little interest in bringing communities together.

"I realise that there's something about Abdul El-Sayed that is very, very evil and on the rise in the United States of America today," Vance said, adding that he was seeking to "destroy" the country.

"My message to Abdul El-Sayed is: You can pal around with terrorist sympathisers, and you can say that America deserved 9/11, or you could empathise not with the children who were targeted at Temple Israel, but with the attacker," the vice-president said.

During his primary, El-Sayed campaigned alongside controversial far-left influencer and Twitch streamer Hasan Piker, who once suggested that the US "deserved" the attacks in New York and Washington.

While El-Sayed never said those words and has since distanced himself from Piker, Vance repeatedly linked the two together during his speech.

In an interview with CNN later on Monday, El-Sayed took his own jabs at Vance, accusing the vice-president of a series of "evil" policies during the Trump administration.

"Evil is ripping healthcare away from working people in exchange for tax breaks for billionaires," El-Sayed said. "Evil is making people pay more for groceries and gas while pushing for trade wars and actual war. Evil is dividing people for your own gain. Evil is selling out your morals for a little bit of power."

He also sought to clarify his previous comments about the Vance family and the Second Lady, saying that he was seeking to demonstrate that Vance "believes in a political philosophy that says that some people are somehow more American than others".

The Michigan Senate race is among the most high profile of the upcoming midterm elections and takes place in a key battleground state that former President Joe Biden won in 2020 and Donald Trump won in 2024.

A survey released earlier this week by Michigan firm Epic-MRA suggests Al-Sayed has a narrow four-point lead over Rogers, a former law enforcement officer with long...
body.zh: 美国副总统 JD 万斯介入了密歇根州激烈的参议院竞选，称民主党新人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德为“邪恶”，因为他在这场激烈的竞选中支持特朗普的盟友迈克·罗杰斯。 在一次支持罗杰斯的活动中，万斯还警告埃尔-赛义德“别提我妻子的名字”，因为这位候选人似乎暗示万斯已故的祖父不会接受印度教徒第二夫人乌莎·万斯。 周一晚些时候，埃尔-赛义德回击万斯，指责特朗普政府推行“邪恶”政策，并“在和平时期发动海外战争”。 最近的民调显示，他在关键战场州以微弱优势领先罗杰斯。 周一晚上，万斯在底特律郊区举行的罗杰斯集会上发表讲话，一再指责穆斯林埃尔赛义德是一个分裂人物，对团结社区毫无兴趣。 万斯说：“我意识到阿卜杜勒·赛义德身上有一些非常非常邪恶的东西，并且在今天的美利坚合众国中呈上升趋势。”他补充说，他正在寻求“摧毁”这个国家。 “我向阿卜杜勒·赛义德传达的信息是：你可以与恐怖分子同情者交朋友，你可以说美国活该9/11，或者你可以不同情以色列圣殿袭击的儿童，而是同情袭击者，”副总统说。 在初选期间，埃尔-赛义德与颇具争议的极左影响者和 Twitch 流媒体哈桑·派克 (Hasan Piker) 一起竞选，后者曾表示美国“活该”遭受纽约和华盛顿的袭击。 虽然埃尔-赛义德从未说过这些话，并且自此与派克保持距离，但万斯在演讲中多次将两者联系在一起。 周一晚些时候，埃尔-赛义德在接受美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 采访时，对万斯进行了猛烈抨击，指责副总统在特朗普执政期间实施了一系列“邪恶”政策。 埃尔-赛义德说：“邪恶正在剥夺劳动人民的医疗保健，以换取亿万富翁的税收减免。” “邪恶是让人们为杂货和汽油支付更多费用，同时推动贸易战和实际战争。邪恶是为了自己的利益而分裂人们。邪恶是为了一点权力而出卖你的道德。” 他还试图澄清他之前对万斯家族和第二夫人的评论，称他试图证明万斯“相信一种政治哲学，即有些人在某种程度上比其他人更美国化”。 密歇根州参议院竞选是即将到来的中期选举中最引人注目的一场，发生在前总统乔·拜登于 2020 年获胜、唐纳德·特朗普于 2024 年获胜的关键战场州。 密歇根公司 Epic-MRA 本周早些时候发布的一项调查显示，阿尔-赛义德以微弱的优势领先罗杰斯 4 个百分点，罗杰斯是一名长期从事执法工作的警官。

reflection.en: Political discourse can quickly devolve into personal insults, where words like 'evil' are weaponized to demonize opponents. Proverbs 18:21 reminds us that words carry immense power, capable of causing deep wounds or offering life. May we pray for leaders to use their speech to build up rather than tear down, fostering understanding even amidst disagreement.
reflection.zh: 政治言论很容易沦为人身攻击，其中“邪恶”这样的词语被用来妖魔化对手。箴言18:21提醒我们，言语具有巨大的力量，能够造成深刻的创伤，也能带来生命。愿我们为领袖们祈祷，求他们用言语来建造而非拆毁，即使在分歧中也能促进理解。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: Congo's Ebola caseload tops 6,000 as concerns grow
title.zh: 刚果埃博拉病例超过6000例，担忧加剧

summary.en: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 6,000 confirmed cases, with nearly 3,000 deaths. As the virus spreads, authorities are racing to contain one of the deadliest outbreaks in history.
summary.zh: 刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情已确认病例超过6000例，死亡人数近3000人。随着病毒蔓延，当局正争分夺秒地遏制这场有史以来最致命的疫情之一。

body.en:
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 6,000 confirmed cases, with nearly 3,000 deaths. As the virus spreads, authorities are racing to contain one of the deadliest outbreaks in history.

The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to escalate, with confirmed infections now topping 6,000 and the death toll reaching 2,911, according to government figures.

The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus , has spread to around 60 zones in six provinces, raising fears that the virus is outpacing efforts to contain it.

"Around 60 health zones are now affected, every week more are added to the list. And the same pattern is repeated everywhere: initially, there is resistance and denial, followed by gradual acceptance," DW correspondent Jonas Gerding reported from Bunia, the capital of the Ituri province, the epicenter of the latest Ebola outbreak in Congo.

"Unfortunately, a lot more people will die until this Ebola outbreak gets under control," he added.

Health experts have said the situation is particularly worrying in eastern Congo, where conflict and insecurity are making it harder for response teams to reach affected communities.

"This outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic on record. It is growing faster and wider than the response to contain it, but it can be stopped," UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres told journalists last week.

The United Nations has appealed for more funding as humanitarian agencies struggle to keep pace with the increasing number of cases.

"International attention, political focus and resources are still lagging behind the reality unfolding on the ground," Guterres said, warning that the world "must also overcome another virus — the virus of indifference."

As researchers continue trials aimed at developing a licensed vaccine for the  Bundibugyo strain , Congolese authorities have rolled out a vaccination campaign focused on front-line health workers.

The vaccine was originally developed for a different Ebola variant, but officials hope it will provide some protection against the current outbreak.

Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba said more than 50,000 doses had already arrived in the country.

"We will cover all the provinces that are around Ituri, moving in a ring towards the center of the outbreak, that is to say towards Ituri. But we have enough doses for all healthcare providers," he said on August 28.

Some health workers remain confident despite uncertainty over how effective the vaccine will be against the Bundibugyo strain.

"It is a vaccine that has already proven itself. We are talking about Ebola Bundibugyo, of Ugandan origin. But the vaccine that they want to administer to us was the vaccine that had...
body.zh: 刚果民主共和国埃博拉疫情确诊病例已突破6000例，近3000人死亡。随着病毒的传播，当局正在竞相遏制历史上最致命的疫情之一。 根据政府数据，刚果民主共和国（DRC）的埃博拉疫情持续升级，目前确诊感染人数已突破 6,000 人，死亡人数达到 2,911 人。 此次疫情由埃博拉病毒本迪布焦毒株引起，已蔓延到六个省份的约 60 个地区，引发人们对该病毒的控制速度超过控制力度的担忧。 德国之声记者 Jonas Gerding 在伊图里省首府布尼亚报道称，“现在大约有 60 个卫生区受到影响，每周都会有更多的卫生区被添加到名单中。同样的模式在各地重复出现：最初是抵制和否认，然后逐渐接受。” 他补充说：“不幸的是，在埃博拉疫情得到控制之前，将会有更多的人死亡。” 卫生专家表示，刚果东部的情况尤其令人担忧，那里的冲突和不安全局势使应对小组更难到达受影响的社区。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯上周对记者表示：“这次疫情是有记录以来增长最快的埃博拉疫情。它的增长速度和范围超出了遏制疫情的应对措施，但它是可以被阻止的。” 由于人道主义机构难以跟上案件数量不断增加的步伐，联合国呼吁提供更多资金。 古特雷斯说：“国际关注、政治焦点和资源仍然落后于当地的现实。”他警告说，世界“还必须战胜另一种病毒——冷漠病毒”。 随着研究人员继续进行旨在开发针对 Bundibugyo 菌株的许可疫苗的试验，刚果当局已推出了针对一线卫生工作者的疫苗接种活动。 该疫苗最初是针对另一种埃博拉病毒变种开发的，但官员希望它能为当前的疫情提供一定的保护。 卫生部长塞缪尔·罗杰·坎巴表示，超过 50,000 剂疫苗已抵达该国。 “我们将覆盖伊图里周边的所有省份，以环形方式向疫情中心移动，也就是说向伊图里移动。但我们有足够的剂量供所有医疗保健提供者使用，”他在 8 月 28 日表示。 尽管疫苗对抗本迪布焦毒株的效果尚不确定，但一些卫生工作者仍然充满信心。 “这是一种已经证明了自己的疫苗。我们正在谈论源自乌干达的埃博拉本迪布焦。但他们想要给我们注射的疫苗是……

reflection.en: The relentless spread of Ebola in Congo, now exceeding 6,000 cases and claiming thousands of lives, speaks to a profound and sustained crisis. In such moments of deep devastation, the ancient words of Lamentations offer a pastoral perspective: Yahweh's mercies are new every morning, a testament to enduring hope even amidst overwhelming loss. This enduring...
reflection.zh: 刚果埃博拉疫情的持续蔓延，已造成超过6000例病例和数千人死亡，这无疑是一场深重而持久的危机。在如此巨大的灾难面前，古老的耶利米哀歌提供了牧养的视角：雅伟的慈爱每早晨都是新的，这是在巨大损失中仍存的持久盼望的见证。这份不变的信实，能成为那些与疾病搏斗的人以及那些不懈努力遏制疫情的医护人员的力量之源。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: US launches more strikes on Iran as state media reports explosions
title.zh: 美国对伊朗发动更多打击，伊朗国家媒体报道爆炸事件

summary.en: US Central Command accused Iran of targeting commercial shipping and American service members deployed in the region. American forces resumed strikes against Iran on Tuesday, US Central Command said in a statement, accusing the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of "recent attempted attacks" against commercial...
summary.zh: 美国中央司令部指责伊朗袭击在该地区部署的商船和美国军人。美国中央司令部周二在一份声明中表示，美军已恢复对伊朗的打击，指责伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）“近期企图袭击”霍尔木兹海峡的商船以及“在该地区部署的美国军人”。

body.en:
American forces resumed strikes against Iran on Tuesday, US Central Command said in a statement.

It accused the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of "recent attempted attacks" against commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and "American service members deployed to the region".

Centcom said US forces began striking IRGC targets at 12:00 ET (16:00 GMT). Iran state media reported the country's deputy governor for security as saying four projectiles had hit the counties of Chabahar and Konarak.

The IRGC said the US would regret the strikes, as US President Donald Trump warned that Iran would be hit again at "a much harder and higher level" if it retaliated.

The attack follows the first known US strikes on Iran since late July earlier this week, when forces attacked two rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait.

Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency reported that several explosions were also heard on Qeshm Island on Tuesday, as well as Konarak and Bandar Abbas.

Donald Trump confirmed the "large and powerful" strikes, which he said were in response to Iran shooting eight missiles at a US military base in Jordan, adding the country had "failed" at adding sea mines to the Strait.

Regarding his threat of a further attack in the case of Iranian retaliation, he added: "It will not be the biggest attack of them all, that is waiting in the wings and, when it is over, there will be very little left of the Islamic Republic of Iran."

IRGC spokesperson Hossein Mohebbi said that severe punishment awaited the US and the country would regret the new attacks.
body.zh: 美国中央司令部在一份声明中表示，美国军队周二恢复对伊朗的打击。 它指责伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）“最近企图袭击”霍尔木兹海峡的商业航运和“部署到该地区的美国军人”。 中央司令部表示，美军于东部时间 12:00（格林尼治标准时间 16:00）开始袭击 IRGC 目标。伊朗官方媒体报道称，该国负责安全的副省长称，四枚炮弹击中了恰巴哈尔县和科纳拉克县。 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，美国将对这些袭击感到遗憾，因为美国总统唐纳德·特朗普警告称，如果伊朗进行报复，将再次受到“更严厉、更高水平”的打击。 此次袭击是美国自本周早些时候七月下旬以来对伊朗进行的首次已知袭击，当时部队袭击了海峡拉拉克岛的两座火箭发射器。 伊朗半官方通讯社塔斯尼姆通讯社报道称，周二格什姆岛以及科纳拉克和阿巴斯港也听到了几起爆炸声。 唐纳德·特朗普证实了这次“大规模而有力”的袭击，他说这是对伊朗向约旦美军基地发射八枚导弹的回应，并补充说该国在海峡布设水雷方面“失败”。 关于他威胁要在伊朗报复的情况下发动进一步袭击，他补充道：“这不会是所有袭击中规模最大的一次，它正在伺机而动，当袭击结束时，伊朗伊斯兰共和国将所剩无几。” 伊斯兰革命卫队发言人侯赛因·莫赫比表示，严厉的惩罚正在等待美国，该国将对新的袭击感到遗憾。

reflection.en: The news reports escalating military strikes and threats of further retaliation between the US and Iran. This cycle of action and counter-action, where each side seems poised to respond to perceived aggression with greater force, mirrors the ancient struggle described in Romans 12:21: "Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good." The temptation...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道了美国和伊朗之间军事打击的升级以及进一步报复的威胁。这种行动与反击的循环，似乎每一方都准备以更大的武力回应其认为的侵略，这与罗马书12:21中所描述的古老斗争相似：“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。”以敌意回应敌意的诱惑很强烈，但呼召却是要通过另一条道路来打破这个循环。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Jurors in Lindsay Clancy trial deadlocked but judge asks them to keep trying
title.zh: 琳赛·克兰西案陪审团僵持不下，但法官要求他们继续审议

summary.en: The Massachusetts mother is facing murder charges for killing her three children at their family home in 2023. Jurors have been deadlocked after three days of deliberations, but the judge has asked them to continue their work.
summary.zh: 这位马萨诸塞州的母亲因于2023年在其家中杀害三个孩子而面临谋杀指控。陪审团在三天的审议后陷入僵局，但法官已要求他们继续工作。

body.en:
Jurors in the trial of Lindsay Clancy are deadlocked after three days of deliberations, but a judge has asked them to keep trying.

Clancy, a resident of Massachusetts, is facing murder charges for killing her three children at their family home in 2023.

Her lawyer does not dispute that the 36-year-old former nurse killed the children, but argues that she was suffering from postpartum psychosis at the time and was unable to distinguish right from wrong.

The Massachusetts mother is charged with three counts of first-degree murder, as the prosecution argues she made a calculated, intentional decision to kill them.

The jury, made up of nine women and three men, began deliberating last week after hearing weeks of testimony from dozens of witnesses.

On Tuesday, audible gasps could be heard in the courtroom as Judge William Sullivan read out a note from the jury indicating that it was deadlocked.

Clancy, who was left paralysed after jumping from a second-floor window shortly after the killings, appeared stoic as she sat in a wheelchair beside her lawyer.

It is not uncommon for jurors in high-profile trials to struggle to reach a decision, and judges have protocols for such situations.

A deadlock among the jury such as this one happens in "complex and emotionally charged trials", Heather Cucolo, a New York Law School professor and expert in mental health law, told the BBC.

"If the deadlock persists, the judge might issue an additional 'dynamite' instruction [known as a Tuey-Rodriguez charge in Massachusetts] to encourage the group to consider alternative perspectives and strive for an agreement while upholding their genuine convictions," Cucolo said.

Clancy is accused of strangling her kids - Cora, five, Dawson, three, and Callan, who was eight months - with fitness bands in their Massachusetts home in January 2023.

The defence argues that Clancy was experiencing postpartum psychosis, a severe mental health condition that can develop after childbirth, and that she should therefore not be held criminally responsible for the killings.

If found guilty of first-degree murder, the intentional and premeditated killing of another person , Clancy will face a mandatory life sentence in prison without the possibility of parole.

She could also be found guilty of a lesser charge, including second-degree murder - committed with malice or extreme recklessness, but without prior planning - or manslaughter - unintentionally killing "by wanton and reckless conduct". In either of those instances, she would face time behind bars.

If she is found not guilty by reason of insanity, she will not be set free - she would instead be sent to a psychiatric hospital where her status would be periodically reviewed. She could stay in hospital for the rest of her life.
body.zh: 林赛·克兰西案的陪审团经过三天的审议陷入僵局，但法官要求他们继续努力。 克兰西是马萨诸塞州居民，因 2023 年在自家杀害了她的三个孩子而面临谋杀指控。 她的律师并不否认这位36岁的前护士杀害了孩子，但辩称她当时患有产后精神病，无法辨别是非。 这位马萨诸塞州的母亲被指控犯有三项一级谋杀罪，检方称她是经过深思熟虑、故意决定杀死他们的。 由九名女性和三名男性组成的陪审团在听取了数十名证人数周的证词后于上周开始审议。 周二，当法官威廉·沙利文宣读陪审团的一份说明，表明法庭陷入僵局时，法庭上可以听到喘息声。 克兰西在杀戮发生后不久从二楼窗户跳下，导致瘫痪，坐在轮椅上的她坐在律师旁边，显得很坚忍。 陪审员在备受瞩目的审判中难以做出决定的情况并不少见，法官对这种情况有处理方案。 纽约法学院教授兼心理健康法专家希瑟·库科洛 (Heather Cucolo) 告诉英国广播公司，像这样的陪审团之间的僵局发生在“复杂且充满情绪的审判”中。 库科洛说：“如果僵局持续存在，法官可能会发布额外的‘爆炸性’指令（在马萨诸塞州被称为 Tuey-Rodriguez 指控），以鼓励该团体考虑其他观点并争取达成协议，同时坚持他们的真实信念。” 克兰西被指控于 2023 年 1 月在马萨诸塞州的家中用健身带勒死了她的孩子——五岁的科拉、三岁的道森和八个月大的卡兰。 辩方辩称，克兰西患有产后精神病，这是一种产后可能出现的严重心理健康状况，因此她不应对杀人事件承担刑事责任。 如果被判犯有一级谋杀罪，即故意和预谋杀害他人的罪名，克兰西将面临强制终身监禁，不得假释。 她还可能被判犯有较轻的罪名，包括二级谋杀——出于恶意或极度鲁莽，但没有事先计划——或过失杀人——“通过肆意和鲁莽的行为”无意中杀人。无论哪种情况，她都将面临牢狱之灾。 如果她因精神错乱而被判无罪，她将不会被释放 - 相反，她会被送往精神病院，在那里她的状况将定期接受检查。她可以在医院度过余生。

reflection.en: This tragic case, where a mother is accused of killing her children, brings to light the devastating impact of severe mental health conditions like postpartum psychosis. The legal system grapples with questions of culpability when psychosis is involved, underscoring the need for compassion and understanding alongside justice. May those affected find healing...
reflection.zh: 这起悲剧案件中，一位母亲被指控杀害了自己的孩子，这暴露了产后精神病等严重精神健康问题带来的毁灭性影响。当精神病发作时，法律体系在罪责问题上陷入困境，这凸显了在追求公正的同时，也需要同情和理解。愿受此影响的人们找到医治，愿社会能更好地支持那些饱受如此深重精神痛苦的人们。

verse.textZh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。

title.en: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
title.zh: 德国称莱比锡机场无人机袭击事件是俄罗斯所为

summary.en: Germany has stated that Russia was responsible for a drone incident at Leipzig/Halle Airport on August 4th, where a drone carrying an explosive device was discovered near Ukrainian cargo planes. The device failed to detonate, and investigators suspect a second drone may have collided with a nearby cargo aircraft....
summary.zh: 德国表示，8月4日发生在莱比锡/哈勒机场的一起无人机事件是俄罗斯所为。当时，一枚携带爆炸装置的无人机在乌克兰货运飞机附近被发现。该装置未能引爆，调查人员怀疑另一架无人机可能在附近与一架货运飞机相撞。德国官员称此次袭击是“俄罗斯在欧洲惯用的混合行动模式”的一部分。

body.en:
Germany has said Russia was responsible for last month's drone attack at Leipzig's airport.

A drone carrying an explosive device was discovered at Leipzig/Halle Airport in eastern Germany, close to Ukrainian cargo planes, on 4 August.

It failed to explode as the detonator was apparently faulty, and investigators suspect a second drone collided with a cargo aircraft nearby. A third drone was reportedly found near the airport 10 days later.

Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said the Leipzig airport attack followed the "well-established pattern of Russian hybrid operations in Europe" and the assumption was that Germany would be targeted again.

He said the that examination of the equipment used along with intelligence findings proved Russian involvement in the attack.

German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul, who was standing beside Dobrindt at a press conference in Berlin, said he would order the closure of the Russian consulate in Bonn, and the contract for the Russian House in Berlin will also be terminated - which many observers have said has been used for espionage and to spread Russian propaganda.

He also announced tighter entry controls for Russian nationals and vowed to increase pressure on Moscow's shadow fleet - old tankers used by Russia to circumvent Western sanctions following its invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

Wadephul said he had summoned the Russia's ambassador to Germany, Sergei Nechayev. He was seen arriving at the foreign ministry shortly after the announcement.

Maria Zakharova, spokesperson for Russia's foreign ministry, said Moscow would respond in a "mirror-image" fashion to Germany's measures.

"Berlin is sponsoring terrorism", she told the German Press Agency in reference to its military and economic support provided to Ukraine.

There have been previous suggestions that the Goethe-Institut in Moscow would have to cease operations if the Germans went through with closing Russian House.

Security experts had speculated that Russia may have been responsible, however Russia has always rejected claims of involvement.

Leipzig/Halle Airport in eastern Germany is used by the Germany military and Nato allies for the transport of military goods and also serves as a base for Ukraine's Antonov Airlines - which carries most of the country's aerial cargo.

The head of Nato, Mark Rutte, said the organisation "stands in full solidarity with Germany".

"The evidence is clear. And I welcome the measures announced by Germany in response," he wrote on X.

The issue was due to be discussed at a meeting of EU foreign ministers in Ireland later on Tuesday.

EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen wrote on X: "We are united in our resolve to stand against Russian aggression. We will deter anyone who seeks to undermine our freedom and...
body.zh: 德国表示，俄罗斯对上个月莱比锡机场发生的无人机袭击事件负责。 8 月 4 日，在德国东部莱比锡/哈勒机场靠近乌克兰货机的地方发现了一架携带爆炸装置的无人机。 由于雷管明显有故障，它未能爆炸，调查人员怀疑第二架无人机与附近的一架货机相撞。 内政部长亚历山大·多布林特表示，8 月 4 日的袭击遵循“俄罗斯在欧洲混合行动的既定模式”，并假设德国将再次成为攻击目标。 安全专家推测俄罗斯可能对此负责，但俄罗斯迄今为止否认参与其中。 德国东部的莱比锡/哈勒机场被德国军方和北约盟国用来运输军用物资，也是乌克兰安东诺夫航空公司的基地，该航空公司承运该国大部分航空货物。 在柏林举行的新闻发布会上，站在多布林特旁边的德国外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔表示，他将下令关闭俄罗斯驻波恩领事馆，柏林俄罗斯之家的合同也将被终止——许多观察家称该建筑已被用于间谍活动和传播俄罗斯宣传。 此突发新闻报道正在更新，更多详细信息将很快发布。请刷新页面以获得完整版本。 您可以通过 BBC 新闻应用程序在智能手机或平板电脑上接收突发新闻。您还可以在外部 X 上关注 @BBCBreaking 以获取最新警报。

reflection.en: The discovery of a drone with an explosive device at Leipzig airport, attributed by Germany to Russian 'hybrid operations,' highlights the insidious nature of conflict that operates below the threshold of open warfare. It raises the question of how to respond when faced with such indirect aggression, which seeks to destabilize and instill fear without...
reflection.zh: 在莱比锡机场发现一枚携带爆炸装置的无人机，德国方面将其归咎于俄罗斯的“混合行动”，这凸显了冲突潜伏于公开战争之下的阴险本质。它提出了一个问题：当面对这种旨在制造不稳定和恐惧而非直接对抗的间接侵略时，应如何回应？古老的智慧提醒我们，要抵制以牙还牙的冲动，而是要寻求通过持之以恒的善来克服邪恶，这是一条艰难但最终更有希望的道路。

title.en: Germany says Russia behind attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport
title.zh: 德国称俄罗斯是莱比锡机场无人机袭击事件的幕后黑手

summary.en: Investigators believe an explosives-laden drone was deliberately targeting a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle airport in early August. The German government said on Tuesday that it held Russia "responsible."
summary.zh: 调查人员认为，8月初在莱比锡/哈勒机场，一枚装有爆炸物的无人机蓄意袭击了一架乌克兰货运飞机。德国政府周二表示，其认为俄罗斯“负有责任”。

body.en:
Investigators believe an explosives-laden drone was deliberately targeting a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle airport in early August. The German government said on Tuesday that it held Russia "responsible."

The German government said on Tuesday that it held  Russia "responsible" for an  attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport  on August 4. 

"The federal government concludes that Russia is responsible for the hybrid attack in Leipzig," said Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt at a press conference in Berlin .

"The means used — such as the drone configuration, components, explosives and detonation systems — are known to us from other hybrid operations by Russia and its war against Ukraine ," added Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul .

He said the attack fit the pattern of a "long series of destabilization operations" against Europe.

Authorities discovered a drone fitted with explosives and a detonation mechanism on the evening of August 4 in the security area of Leipzig/Halle Airport between Ukrainian cargo aircraft and believe a second drone may have collided with a DHL aircraft nearby.

Last week, German media reported a third drone, also loaded with explosives, had also been discovered at the airport. 

German federal prosecutors described the incident as a "serious attack on Germany's transport and logistics infrastructure."

"Taken together, police investigations, patterns of the crime and intelligence findings substantiate Russian responsibility for the attempted attack at Leipzig Airport," said Interior Minister Dobrindt on Tuesday.

"We do not view Leipzig as an isolated incident, but rather see it in the context of other hybrid actions," he continued. "We assume that Germany will be the target of further hybrid attacks by Russia."

Dobrindt insisted that Germany is "not at war" but that it is "a daily target of hybrid warfare."

Therefore, he said, Germany would respond to the hybrid attack in Leipzig in a "proportionate and measured, yet resolute manner."

Foreign Minister Wadephul said Germany's response would be coordinated closely with European Union and NATO partners.

In addition to a strengthening of internal security, he also announced additional measures including the closure of the Russian consulate in the western city of Bonn from September 18 and the rescinding of a contract enabling the operation of the "Russian House," a Russian cultural center in Berlin.

"Our message to the Russian leadership is clear," said Wadephul. "We are sticking to our security course. The attack on Leipzig shows that this is necessary. We will not allow our social cohesion to be divided by Russian attacks. We remain ready to react along with our partners when the protection of our...
body.zh: 调查人员认为，八月初，一架载有爆炸物的无人机故意瞄准莱比锡/哈勒机场的一架乌克兰货机。德国政府周二表示，俄罗斯应承担“责任”。 德国政府周二表示，俄罗斯对 8 月 4 日莱比锡/哈雷机场发生的无人机袭击未遂事件“负责”。 内政部长亚历山大·多布林特在柏林举行的新闻发布会上表示：“联邦政府得出的结论是，俄罗斯应对莱比锡的混合袭击负责。” 外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔补充道：“我们从俄罗斯其他混合行动及其对乌克兰的战争中了解到了所使用的手段，例如无人机配置、组件、炸药和引爆系统。” 他表示，这次袭击符合针对欧洲的“长期一系列破坏稳定行动”的模式。 8 月 4 日晚，当局在莱比锡/哈勒机场的安全区域发现一架装有炸药和引爆装置的无人机，位于乌克兰货机之间，并认为第二架无人机可能与附近的一架 DHL 飞机相撞。 上周，德国媒体报道称，在机场还发现了第三架同样装载爆炸物的无人机。 德国联邦检察官将这一事件描述为“对德国运输和物流基础设施的严重攻击”。 内政部长多布林特周二表示：“总的来说，警方的调查、犯罪模式和情报调查结果证实了俄罗斯对莱比锡机场袭击未遂事件负有责任。” “我们并不认为莱比锡事件是一个孤立的事件，而是将其视为其他混合行动的背景，”他继续说道。 “我们认为德国将成为俄罗斯进一步混合攻击的目标。” 多布林特坚称德国“没有处于战争状态”，但它是“混合战争的日常目标”。 因此，他表示，德国将以“适度、谨慎但坚决的方式”应对莱比锡的混合袭击。 外交部长瓦德菲尔表示，德国将与欧盟和北约伙伴密切协调应对措施。 除了加强内部安全外，他还宣布了其他措施，包括从9月18日起关闭俄罗斯驻西部城市波恩的领事馆，并撤销允许柏林俄罗斯文化中心“俄罗斯之家”运营的合同。 瓦德菲尔说：“我们向俄罗斯领导人传达的信息是明确的。” “我们坚持我们的安全路线。对莱比锡的袭击表明这是必要的。我们不会允许我们的社会凝聚力因俄罗斯的袭击而分裂。当我们的……受到保护时，我们随时准备与我们的合作伙伴一起做出反应。”

reflection.en: The accusation that Russia is responsible for the drone attack at Leipzig airport highlights the ongoing cycle of conflict and retaliation. In such moments, the temptation is to respond in kind, mirroring the aggression faced. Yet, the call remains to actively choose a different path, overcoming harmful actions not with more harm, but with steadfast...
reflection.zh: 指控俄罗斯对莱比锡机场的无人机袭击负责，凸显了冲突和报复的持续循环。在这样的时刻，人们很容易以牙还牙，模仿所遭受的侵略。然而，呼召依然是选择一条不同的道路，用坚定的良善和真理来克服有害的行为，而不是以更多的伤害来回应。

title.en: War and sanctions deepen Iran's fuel crisis
title.zh: 战争与制裁加剧伊朗燃料危机

summary.en: Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints, and new US sanctions squeeze supplies. Drivers report hours-long waits, with some arriving before midnight or sleeping in their cars to secure fuel. The situation is even more difficult for diesel.
summary.zh: 由于战争破坏、进口限制和新的美国制裁导致供应紧张，伊朗各地的加油站排起了长队。司机们报告说需要排数小时的队，有些人甚至在午夜前就到场或睡在车里以确保获得燃料。柴油的情况甚至更加困难。

body.en:
Long lines at fuel stations are spreading across Iran as war damage, import constraints and new US sanctions squeeze supplies.

Only days after Washington announced a new round of economic sanctions on Iran , the country's gasoline shortage has become increasingly visible on the streets.  

In cities across Iran , drivers are reporting hours-long waits at filling stations. Videos circulating on social media show some people arriving before midnight or sleeping in their cars to secure fuel the following morning. Some stations are closing before serving everyone in line.

The situation is even more difficult for diesel. Truck drivers say queues at filling stations near major cities can stretch for kilometers, forcing them to wait overnight simply to obtain enough fuel to return to work.

Iran already faces a gasoline deficit of roughly 15 million liters (ca. 4 million gallons) a day. War damage, difficulties importing refined products and a tightening US blockade have made an old structural problem much harder to manage.

A resident of Karaj, a city west of the capital Tehran, told DW that some filling stations were limiting individual purchases to around five liters.

"I'm in the gasoline line right now. It took about 45 minutes just to get this far," he said. "Yesterday I went to several stations. Some were closed, some had no gasoline and others had very long queues."

He said he returned at 6 a.m. the next morning hoping to avoid the crowds but again found a long line.

He suspects the shortages are partly being used to prepare public opinion for higher gasoline prices , a claim that could not be independently verified.

"Our whole life is either spent in the diesel line or on the road," one driver said. He described sleeping at a station while waiting for a tanker that might arrive around midday and supply only a few dozen trucks.

Another driver said he had been waiting since 8 a.m. after failing to obtain diesel the previous day.

For drivers whose earnings depend directly on keeping their vehicles moving, every lost day adds to rising insurance, tyre, oil, repair and maintenance costs.

The shortage has coincided with the use of methanol in domestically produced gasoline.

Vahid Ghaneifard, chief executive of Persian Gulf Star Oil Company, recently confirmed that the refinery had begun testing methanol as an oxygenate in its gasoline.

The company says methanol makes up around 0.5% of the mixture. Iran's refining authorities say the national fuel standard permits methanol concentrations of up to 3%.

Videos shared online show motorists holding bottles of unusually clear fuel and claiming that gasoline quality has deteriorated.

Some have alleged that water or excessive alcohol is being mixed into supplies. The allegations have not...
body.zh: 由于战争破坏、进口限制和美国新制裁挤压了供应，伊朗各地加油站排起了长队。 就在华盛顿宣布对伊朗实施新一轮经济制裁几天后，该国的汽油短缺问题在街头变得越来越明显。 在伊朗各地的城市，司机们都报告说在加油站要等待数小时。社交媒体上流传的视频显示，一些人在午夜前到达或睡在车里，以确保第二天早上有燃料。有些车站在为排队的所有人提供服务之前就已经关闭。 对于柴油机来说，情况更加困难。卡车司机表示，主要城市附近加油站的排队队伍可能长达数公里，迫使他们彻夜等待，以获得足够的燃料返回工作岗位。 伊朗已面临每天约 1500 万升的汽油短缺。战争造成的破坏、进口成品油的困难以及美国收紧的封锁使得这个古老的结构性问题更加难以解决。 德黑兰西部卡拉季的一名居民告诉德国之声，一些加油站将个人购买量限制在五升左右。 “我现在正在加油线上。花了大约 45 分钟才走到这一步，”他说。 “昨天我去了几个车站。有些车站关门了，有些没有汽油了，还有的还排着很长的队。” 他说，他第二天早上 6 点回来，希望避开人群，但又发现排着长队。 他怀疑短缺在一定程度上被用来为汽油价格上涨做好舆论准备，这一说法无法得到独立证实。 “我们的一生要么在柴油管道上度过，要么在路上度过，”一位司机说。他描述说，他在车站睡觉，等待一辆油罐车，这辆油罐车可能在中午左右到达，只能供应几十辆卡车。 另一名司机表示，由于前一天未能获得柴油，他从早上 8 点就开始等待。 对于收入直接依赖于保持车辆行驶的司机来说，每损失一天都会增加保险、轮胎、机油、维修和保养成本。 短缺与国内生产的汽油中使用甲醇同时发生。 波斯湾之星石油公司首席执行官瓦希德·加内法德 (Vahid Ghaneifard) 最近证实，该炼油厂已开始测试甲醇作为汽油中的含氧化合物。 该公司表示，甲醇占混合物的 0.5% 左右。伊朗炼油当局表示，国家燃料标准允许甲醇浓度最高为3%。 网上分享的视频显示，驾车者拿着异常透明的汽油瓶，声称汽油质量已经恶化。 一些人声称，供应品中混入了​​水或过量酒精。这些指控尚未得到独立证实。 有，...

In such times of severe economic strain, Habakkuk’s words offer a profound perspective: even when the harvest fails and livestock perish, there is a source of enduring joy and strength in Yahweh. This ancient lament reminds us that true sustenance...
reflection.zh: 伊朗人民正面临巨大的困境，因为燃料短缺，影响了日常生活和生计。在如此严峻的经济压力下，哈巴谷的话提供了一个深刻的视角：即使收成歉收，牲畜灭绝，在雅伟里仍有持久的喜乐和力量之源。 这古老的哀歌提醒我们，真正的滋养超越物质的匮乏。它呼唤我们超越眼前的苦难，看到更深的盼望，在匮乏中找到忠诚所带来的韧性，甚至喜乐。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: Mladic's death, Bosnia and Serbia's unfinished reckoning
title.zh: 姆拉迪奇之死，波黑与塞尔维亚未竟的清算

summary.en: The death of Ratko Mladic did not conclude a dark chapter of European history; instead, it reopened old wounds, demonstrating that the Dayton Accords and subsequent international efforts failed to address the root causes of the Bosnian war. The ideology that fueled the conflict persists.
summary.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的去世并未结束欧洲历史上的黑暗篇章；相反，它重新撕裂了旧伤口，表明结束波斯尼亚战争的《代顿协议》以及随后的国际努力，都未能触及冲突的根源。催生这场冲突的意识形态依然存在。

body.en:
The death of Ratko Mladic did not close a dark chapter of European history; it reopened old wounds. The ideology that created him lives on. The Dayton peace agreement ended the war, not the divisions that produced it.

The death of Ratko Mladic should have closed one of the darkest chapters in European history.

Instead, it has reopened old wounds, proving that both the Dayton Accords that ended the 1992-95 Bosnian war and the three decades of international engagement that followed never came close to addressing the causes that led to the conflict.

When Mladic , the former commander of the Bosnian Serb army, died on August 27, 2026 in a prison hospital in The Hague, his conviction for genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes — including the 1995 Srebrenica massacre and the siege of Sarajevo — had been final for nearly a decade.

What was never settled, however — and what, it seems, was never even seriously attempted — is the question of how a society lives with a man who remains a convicted criminal in the eyes of an international court but is viewed by some as a hero and symbol of the Serbian people.

For this reason, the reactions that followed Mladic' s death came as no surprise.

In Serbia and the Serb-dominated Republika Srpska , one of the two semi-autonomous entities created within Bosnia-Herzegovina by the 1995 Dayton Peace Agreement, Mladic's death was mourned as the loss of a national hero, not the end of an era of crimes — a narrative that stands in direct contradiction to the facts established by international courts.

Senior officials in Republika Srpska, which covers around 49% of the territory of the former Yugoslav republic of Bosnia-Herzegovina, called on citizens to gather in squares and light candles "for the salvation of the general's soul."

Milorad Dodik , still the most powerful political figure in Republika Srpska despite stepping down as its president last year after a six-year ban on holding public office imposed by Bosnia's constitutional court, called Mladic's death a "murder," suggesting it was "an organized approach that was meant to lead to a fatal outcome."

In Banja Luka, the de facto capital of Republika Srpska, Mayor Drasko Stanivukovic expressed his condolences to Mladic's family and confirmed that Mladic is not perceived as a man convicted of genocide but as a symbol of "a time and a struggle."

Serbia's justice minister announced a funeral with the highest state and military honors.

President Aleksandar Vucic accused the tribunal in The Hague of "uncivilized behavior" for not allowing Mladic to spend his final days outside his prison cell.

Former Interior Minister Aleksandar Vulin spoke of Mladic in the same breath as other Serbian national heroes, invoking a narrative...
body.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的去世并没有结束欧洲历史的黑暗篇章；它重新揭开了旧伤。创造他的意识形态仍然存在。代顿和平协议结束了战争，而不是导致战争的分裂。 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的去世本应结束欧洲历史上最黑暗的篇章之一。 相反，它重新揭开了旧伤，证明结束 1992-95 年波斯尼亚战争的《代顿协议》和随后三十年的国际接触从未接近解决导致冲突的根源。 当波斯尼亚塞族军队前指挥官姆拉迪奇于 2026 年 8 月 27 日在海牙一家监狱医院去世时，他犯下的种族灭绝罪、反人类罪和战争罪——包括 1995 年斯雷布雷尼察大屠杀和萨拉热窝围困——的定罪已经持续了近十年。 然而，从未得到解决——而且似乎从未认真尝试过——的问题是，一个在国际法庭眼中仍然是被定罪的罪犯，但被一些人视为英雄和塞尔维亚人民象征的人，社会如何生活。 因此，姆拉迪奇去世后的反应也就不足为奇了。 在塞尔维亚和塞族统治的塞族共和国（1995年代顿和平协议在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那境内创建的两个半自治实体之一），姆拉迪奇的去世被视为民族英雄的逝去，而不是一个犯罪时代的结束——这种说法与国际法院确立的事实直接矛盾。 占前南斯拉夫波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那共和国约49%领土的塞族共和国的高级官员呼吁公民聚集在广场上并点燃蜡烛，“以拯救将军的灵魂”。 米洛拉德·多迪克仍然是塞族共和国最有权势的政治人物，尽管去年因波斯尼亚宪法法院禁止担任公职六年而辞去总统职务，他称姆拉迪奇之死是一场“谋杀”，暗示这是“一种有组织的做法，旨在导致致命的结果”。 在塞族共和国事实上的首都巴尼亚卢卡，市长德拉斯科·斯塔尼武科维奇向姆拉迪奇的家人表示哀悼，并确认姆拉迪奇不被视为一个被判犯有种族灭绝罪的人，而是“一个时代和一场斗争”的象征。 塞尔维亚司法部长宣布以最高国家和军事荣誉举行葬礼。 总统亚历山大·武契奇指责海牙法庭“行为不文明”，不允许姆拉迪奇在牢房外度过他的最后几天。 前内政部长亚历山大·武林将姆拉迪奇与其他塞尔维亚民族英雄相提并论，并援引了这样的故事……

reflection.en: The news of Ratko Mladic's death, rather than closing a chapter, has reopened old wounds in Bosnia and Serbia. It underscores how peace agreements can end wars but not the deep divisions that produced them. The hope remains that ultimately, Yahweh will bring an end to conflict and disarm the nations.
reflection.zh: 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的去世并未能合上历史的一页，反而重新撕裂了波黑和塞尔维亚的旧伤口。这突显了和平协议可以结束战争，却难以弥合导致冲突的深刻分歧。然而，人们仍怀有盼望，相信雅伟终将平息争战，使列国放下武​​器。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

body.en:
Heavy Israeli bombardment killed three people in Gaza City on Tuesday, Palestinian health officials said, in what both sides described as an Israeli-backed ground operation to seize a senior Hamas figure.

Eyewitnesses reported around a dozen strikes on Tuesday morning in western Gaza City, where the territory's civil defence agency said three people were killed, including two children and a woman.

Eight people were wounded, according to the civil defence, which operates as a rescue force under Hamas authority. Gaza City's Al-Shifa Hospital confirmed it had received the bodies and the wounded.

Speaking on the Israeli side of the Gaza border, Defence Minister Israel Katz announced that "a senior Hamas terrorist was arrested" without naming the person or giving further details.

"We do not wait for threats, but hunt down Hamas terrorists, thwart them, and destroy their terror infrastructure," Katz said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The outspoken minister boasted that due to Israeli strikes since Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack, nearly 70 percent of Gaza has been destroyed and under Israeli military control "with no residents, no tunnels, and no houses".

Security sources in Gaza gave a different account, with one telling AFP the Israeli mission against a prominent Hamas figure was thwarted and that special forces withdrew "on motorcycles under Israeli cover".

The forces included an Israeli-allied militia inside Gaza, which Hamas has controlled for years, he said.

Ismail al-Thawabta, head of Hamas's media office in Gaza, said an Israeli special forces operation was "exposed during the mission", prompting heavy airstrikes in the area.

The bombardment also resulted in the "killing of a number of members of the special force that attempted to carry out the mission", Thawabta wrote on X.

The Israeli military said it struck "several targets in the Gaza Strip in order to remove threats to the security forces", without specifying where the strikes took place or giving any further information.

Separately, in the central Gaza Strip, Al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir al-Balah reported that Israeli fire killed two other people including a girl.

Despite a US-backed ceasefire that took effect in October 2025, violence has not halted in the Gaza Strip, with Israel continuing to target Palestinians it says are militants.

Israeli operations in Gaza have killed at least 1,318 people since the ceasefire came into effect, according to the Palestinian territory's health ministry, which also operates under Hamas authority and whose figures are considered reliable by the United Nations.

The Israeli army has reported five deaths in its ranks over the same period, as...

reflection.en: The news from Gaza reports the tragic deaths of civilians, including children and a woman, amidst an operation. In times of conflict, the voices of the most vulnerable are often lost. This passage calls us to remember those who cannot speak for themselves and to advocate for justice and protection for all, especially the defenseless.
reflection.zh: 加沙传来的消息令人痛心，报道了在一次行动中包括儿童和妇女在内的平民不幸身亡。在冲突时期，最弱势群体的声音常常被淹没。这段经文呼吁我们铭记那些无法为自己发声的人，并为所有人，特别是手无寸铁者，争取公义和保护。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: What's behind the 'biggest oil deal in world history' Trump is touting with Venezuela?
title.zh: 特朗普吹嘘的与委内瑞拉的“史上最大石油交易”背后是什么？

summary.en: Critics say the deal is the reason the Trump administration captured then-president Nicolás Maduro in a raid earlier this year. Details are emerging about what United States President Donald Trump is calling "the biggest oil deal in world history" with Venezuela. Trump said the agreement announced on Saturday would...
summary.zh: 批评人士称，这项协议是特朗普政府今年早些时候突袭抓捕委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗的原因。有关美国总统唐纳德·特朗普所称的“史上最大石油交易”的细节正在浮出水面。特朗普表示，周六宣布的协议将使美国获得委内瑞拉庞大石油储备的股份，这是他从该国获取能源目标的一步，此前美军于一月份的一次午夜突袭中抓获了时任总统尼古拉斯·马杜...

body.en:
Details are emerging about what United States President Donald Trump is calling "the biggest oil deal in world history" with Venezuela.

Trump said the agreement announced on Saturday would give the US a stake in Venezuela's vast oil reserves, a step toward his goal of extracting energy from the country after US forces captured then-president Nicolás Maduro in a middle-of-the-night raid in January and brought him to New York to face federal drug trafficking charges.

Venezuela's acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, described the deal as a step toward economic recovery that will modernise the country’s oil industry.

In a televised address to the nation on Sunday, Rodríguez insisted Venezuela's sovereignty is secure and said she wants the country to become a global energy powerhouse.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The US government and a private operator in Venezuela have formed a new company that has been granted rights to access untapped oil fields for 100 years.

A statement from Rodríguez said the deal involves the development of 17 fields with a proven potential of 65 billion barrels.

It said the agreement could draw US$100 billion ($139 billion) in investment into Venezuela's oil industry and yield over US$209 billion ($291 billion) in taxes for the country.

The private operator is North America Blue Energy Partners, owned by Alejandro Betancourt, the White House confirmed on Tuesday.

The company currently produces about 200,000 barrels a day, which makes it the second-largest private operator in Venezuela behind Chevron, according to a source who spoke on condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to release the information.

Trump said the agreement was negotiated by US secretary of state Marco Rubio, defence secretary Pete Hegseth and Rodríguez.

The deal will give the US a 35 per cent ownership stake in the company, and the US state department will get a guarantee to buy 20 per cent of the output at cost. US purchases of oil will go towards US strategic oil reserves along with the military, according to a US official who was not authorised to discuss the matter publicly and spoke on the condition of anonymity.

The company would be the second largest corporate holder of proven reserves after Saudi Aramco, according to the US official.

Bob McNally, who was an energy adviser in former US president George W Bush's administration, said the current administration appears to be seeking ways to make it easier for the private sector to invest in Venezuela's industry through the deal.

"However, investors will remain cautious even if the terms of the deal, once released, pass legal muster. A future...

Such events raise questions about power dynamics and the potential for exploitation, reminding us of the biblical warning against oppressive rule. The pursuit of national interest, when unchecked by justice, can lead to actions that...

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.

title.en: Three decades after Tupac's death, a jury has reached a verdict
title.zh: 图帕克去世三十年后，陪审团做出裁决

body.en:
A Las Vegas jury found an ex-gang leader guilty of murder on Tuesday in a case accusing him of plotting the drive-by killing of legendary hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur, bringing a decades-old cold case to a close.

Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, was charged in Nevada's Clark County with a single count of murder using a deadly weapon. He had pleaded not guilty.

Davis was accused of leading a group of men to kill Shakur, who was one of rap's most commercially successful and influential artists, in retaliation for the beating of Davis' nephew.

Police had said they long suspected Davis but did not have enough evidence to charge him until he went public with his story in media appearances and a memoir, which, along with tapes of his secret meetings with investigators, made up the bulk of the prosecution’s case.

Davis' lawyer said his client's words were mere bravado and could not be corroborated by other evidence.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The trial began on 17 August. Prosecutors played hours of recorded conversations in which Davis said he was enraged after Shakur and his entourage beat up Davis’ nephew at a Las Vegas casino on 7 September 1996.

Davis and three other men, including his nephew, went looking for Shakur and record label executive Marion "Suge" Knight in a white Cadillac on the night of the beating, he said. Davis said he passed a gun to the backseat, and when they found Knight and Shakur’s car, one of the two men in the back opened fire.

Prosecutors have not named the shooter, and the three other men who were in the car have since died. Under Nevada law, Davis can be charged with murder even though he did not pull the trigger.

Davis was a leader of the Southside Compton Crips, a Los Angeles-area street gang that feuded with rival gang Mob Piru, which was associated with Shakur and his record label Death Row Records.

Shakur's killing in 1996 became a seminal moment in rap history and heightened hip-hop culture's violent image during 'gangsta' rap's heyday, an era defined by feuding between East and West Coast artists.

body.zh: 周二，拉斯维加斯陪审团裁定一名前帮派头目犯有谋杀罪，指控他密谋驾车杀害传奇嘻哈艺术家图帕克·沙库尔 (Tupac Shakur)，从而结束了这起长达数十年的悬案。 63 岁的杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯 (Duane "Keffe D" Davis) 在内华达州克拉克县被指控犯有一项使用致命武器谋杀罪。他不认罪。 戴维斯被指控带领一群人杀害沙库尔，沙库尔是说唱界在商业上最成功和最有影响力的艺术家之一，以报复殴打戴维斯的侄子。 警方表示，他们长期以来一直怀疑戴维斯，但没有足够的证据来指控他，直到他在媒体上公开自己的故事和一本回忆录，其中加上他与调查人员秘密会面的录音，构成了检方案件的大部分。 戴维斯的律师表示，他当事人的言论只是虚张声势，无法得到其他证据的证实。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 审判于8月17日开始。检察官播放了数小时的对话录音，戴维斯表示，1996 年 9 月 7 日，沙库尔及其随行人员在拉斯维加斯赌场殴打戴维斯的侄子后，他感到非常愤怒。 戴维斯说，在遭到殴打的当晚，戴维斯和包括他侄子在内的另外三名男子开着一辆白色凯迪拉克去寻找沙库尔和唱片公司高管马里昂·“苏格”·奈特。戴维斯说，他把枪递到后座，当他们发现奈特和沙库尔的车时，后座的两名男子中的一个开枪了。 检察官尚未透露枪手的姓名，车内的其他三名男子现已死亡。根据内华达州法律，即使戴维斯没有扣动扳机，也可以被指控谋杀。 戴维斯是洛杉矶地区街头帮派南区康普顿克里普斯 (Southside Compton Crips) 的头目，该帮派与竞争对手帮派 Mob Piru 不和，后者与沙库尔及其唱片公司 Death Row Records 有联系。 1996 年 Shakur 被杀成为说唱史上的一个重要时刻，并提升了嘻哈文化在“黑帮”说唱全盛时期的暴力形象，这个时代的特点是东海岸和西海岸艺术家之间的不和。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: After three decades, justice has been served for the murder of Tupac Shakur. The conviction of Duane "Keffe D" Davis stems from a plot to retaliate for a prior assault. This case highlights how cycles of violence, born from a desire for revenge, can ensnare individuals and communities for generations. May we seek to overcome evil with good, breaking these...
reflection.zh: 三十年后，图帕克·夏库尔（Tupac Shakur）的谋杀案终于得到了审判。杜安（Duane "Keffe D" Davis）的定罪源于一次报复性的杀人计划。此案凸显了复仇心驱使下的暴力循环如何能世世代代地困住个人和社群。愿我们寻求以善胜恶，打破这些毁灭性的模式。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Albanese responds after China warns of 'consequences' over Taiwan at Pacific summit
title.zh: 中国警告台湾出席太平洋岛国论坛将带来“后果”

summary.en: China's top diplomat for Pacific Island Countries, Qian Bo, has warned of 'consequences' regarding Taiwan's presence as a development partner at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau. He expressed China's 'serious concerns' and called Taiwan's participation 'inappropriate,' though he denied...
summary.zh: 中国太平洋岛国事务特使钱波警告，台湾作为太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议的发展伙伴出席将带来“后果”。他表达了中国“严重关切”，并称台湾的参与“不恰当”，但他否认其言论是威胁。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has stopped short of criticising China over threats of "consequences" for Taiwan's attendance at an annual Pacific summit, saying the forum decides who takes part.

Albanese's comments follow a warning from China's top Pacific Islands diplomat, who said "there will always be consequences" for Taiwan's strong presence at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, with the highly charged three-day talks officially starting on Tuesday.

Albanese said he was "not distracted" when asked if Taiwan's presence was a distraction. Asked if he thought it was appropriate for China to make threats, the prime minister said: "The Pacific Islands Forum determines what happens here, not any other country."

Earlier, China's special envoy for Pacific Island affairs, Qian Bo, denied his comments were a threat, but said China has "serious concerns" about Taiwan's status as a development partner at the forum.

"There will always be consequences. You know, this is objected to by all, so this should not have happened. We think it's very inappropriate to do so," he told Australian reporters while leaving the forum's opening ceremony on Monday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. Beijing views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary .

Like the United States, Australia recognises and has formal ties with China, but maintains unofficial ties with Taiwan.

Neither China nor Taiwan are part of the 18-member group at the forum, but countries including the United States and China have traditionally been invited as dialogue partners. Taiwan has been categorised as a development partner since 1993 and is being represented this year by foreign minister Lin Chia-lung, along with a sizeable delegation.

Palau is one of only three Pacific nations to have diplomatic relations with Taiwan, which has created great friction between the hosts and China over the past decade. In 2017, China placed de facto "tourist bans" on the tiny Micronesian country, which received 40 per cent of its GDP from the tourism industry, in an apparent attempt to sway Palau's diplomatic position away from Taiwan.

Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr said on Sunday he was aware there would be "threats" of retaliation if Taiwan attended this year's talks.

"Let's not use this as a place that we should be threatening or making people feel uncomfortable," he told reporters.

"China doesn't tell us that we cannot be a partner to Taiwan. That is our sovereign decision, not their decision."

Qian also claimed China has the "understanding and...
body.zh: 中国太平洋岛国最高外交官警告说，台湾在帕劳举行的太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议上的强势参与“总会产生后果”，拉开了周二正式开始的为期三天的高度紧张的会谈。 北京太平洋岛国事务特使钱波否认他的言论构成威胁，但表示中国对台湾在论坛上作为发展伙伴的地位“严重关切”。 “总会有后果的。你知道，这是所有人都反对的，所以这不应该发生。我们认为这样做是非常不合适的，”他在周一离开开幕式时告诉澳大利亚记者。 中国和台湾都不属于该论坛的 18 个成员国，但美国和中国等国家历来被邀请作为对话伙伴。台湾自1993年起就被列为发展伙伴，今年由外交部长林家龙率领一个规模庞大的代表团出席。 帕劳是仅有的三个与台湾建交的太平洋国家之一，过去十年来，东道主与中国之间产生了巨大摩擦。 2017年，北京对这个密克罗尼西亚小国实施了事实上的“旅游禁令”，该国GDP的40%来自旅游业，显然是试图动摇帕劳的外交立场，使其远离台北。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯周日表示，他知道如果台湾参加今年的会谈，将会有“报复威胁”。 他对记者说：“我们不要把这里当作我们应该威胁或让人们感到不舒服的地方。” “中国没有告诉我们，我们不能成为台湾的合作伙伴。这是我们的主权决定，而不是他们的决定。” 钱其琛还声称，中国得到了PIF“大多数”成员国的“理解和支持”，并向帕劳“非常明确”地表明了自己的立场。 今年的PIF在正式开始前就陷入了争议，六位领导人被确认缺席，其中包括即将离任的论坛主席、所罗门群岛总理马修·韦尔，以及基里巴斯亲北京总统塔内蒂·马毛，后者特意派了前驻华大使大卫·蒂博代替。 他们缺席的原因包括国家议会职责和健康问题，威尔士已抵达科罗尔，并被迫在周末返回家乡，以应对可能的领导挑战。但缺席的关键领导人让人怀疑，在为期三天的活动中，是否可以就关键议程项目（包括气候行动）采取有意义的集体行动……

reflection.en: As leaders gather in Palau for the Pacific Islands Forum, diplomatic tensions simmer. China's envoy has voiced strong objections to Taiwan's participation, warning of 'consequences.' In such moments of heightened political friction, the call to pursue peace and seek diplomatic solutions, even amidst disagreement, remains paramount.
reflection.zh: 在太平洋岛国论坛领导人在帕劳举行会议之际，外交紧张局势悄然升温。中国特使对台湾的参与表达了强烈反对，并警告将有“后果”。在政治摩擦加剧的时刻，即使存在分歧，寻求和平与外交解决方案的呼吁仍然至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。
