title.en: Nepal-Tibet flood deaths pass 1,000 as police ask relatives for DNA to identify victims
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水死亡人数超过1000人，警方要求亲属提供DNA以识别遇难者

summary.en: Relatives of missing tourists were asked for blood samples and photos as rescue efforts continued for hundreds of hydropower workers trapped in the Himalayas. The death toll from devastating floods has surpassed 1,000 nearly a week after the disaster struck towns and valleys across Nepal and Tibet.
summary.zh: 在喜马拉雅山区搜救数百名被困水电站工人的同时，失踪游客的亲属被要求提供血样和照片。在毁灭性洪水袭击尼泊尔和西藏的城镇和山谷近一周后，死亡人数已超过1000人。

body.en: Relatives of missing tourists asked for blood samples and photos, as efforts continue to rescue trapped hydropower workers Nepal-Tibet floods – latest updates Visual guide: How the Nepal-Tibet flash flood unfolded Nepali rescuers have built temporary bridges to reach remote areas and dug through the ruins of hydropower projects in the Himalayas to rescue hundreds of trapped workers, as the death toll passed 1,000 nearly ⁠a week after devastating ​floods left a trail of destruction across the country’s towns and valleys. About 600 people remain stuck in several devastated hydropower stations that have become the focus of rescue efforts. The prime ⁠minister, Balendra Shah, said more than 11,000 people had been rescued across the affected region, and power and communication lines had been restored in some areas. Continue reading...
body.zh: 失踪游客的亲属要求提供血样和照片，同时继续努力营救被困的水电工人。 尼泊尔-西藏洪水——最新动态 视觉指南：尼泊尔-西藏山洪爆发的过程 尼泊尔救援人员建造了临时桥梁，到达偏远地区，并在喜马拉雅山的水电项目废墟中挖掘，以营救数百名被困工人。毁灭性洪水在该国城镇造成严重破坏，近一周后死亡人数已超过 1,000 人。和山谷。几个被毁的水电站仍有约600人被困，这些水电站已成为救援工作的重点。总理巴伦德拉·沙阿 (Balendra Shah) 表示，受影响地区已有 11,000 多人获救，部分地区的电力和通讯线路已恢复。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have claimed over 1,000 lives, leaving a trail of destruction and immense grief. In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible, 'Jesus wept,' speaks volumes. It shows that divine empathy is present even in our deepest sorrow, acknowledging the pain without offering easy answers.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性的洪水已造成1000多人死亡，留下了满目疮痍和巨大的悲痛。在如此深切的失落时刻，圣经中最短的一节经文“耶稣哭了”意义深远。它表明，即使在我们最深的悲伤中，神圣的同情也与我们同在，承认痛苦，却不提供廉价的慰藉。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Nepal-Tibet floods: millions at risk from glacial floods in Himalayas in years to come, UN warns, as death toll passes 1,000 – as it happened
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水：死亡人数超过1000人，救援工作仍在水电站隧道进行——最新消息

summary.en: The death toll from catastrophic flooding in Nepal and Tibet has surpassed 1,000, with approximately 4,500 people missing. Hundreds of unidentified victims have reportedly been buried as morgues were overwhelmed. Rescue efforts continue, but hopes are fading for those trapped in mud-filled tunnels at hydropower sites.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏地区灾难性的洪水造成的死亡人数已超过1000人，约有4500人失踪。据报道，由于太平间不堪重负，数百名身份不明的遇难者已被埋葬。救援工作仍在继续，但被困在水电站泥泞隧道中的失踪人员获救的希望渺茫。

body.en: ‘Technology cannot move fast enough to prevent loss’, official says, as rescue efforts for the 4,500 still missing continue Nepal last week turned down foreign ​involvement in general search and rescue but said it needed specialised services and advanced technological support in areas such as life-detecting machines, large refrigerators and pre-fabricated bridges. Aid worth more than $42m has poured into the country and Nepal is now working with experts from other countries to help with rescue operations. Continue reading...
body.zh: 官员称，截至周二上午，尼泊尔和中国发生的特大洪水造成的死亡人数已超过 1,000 人，据报道，洪水淹没了太平间，当局正在埋葬数百名身份不明的遇难者。 尼泊尔救灾机构在周二发布的最新消息中称，该国已统计出 987 人死亡、3,916 人失踪，其中包括 583 名外国人。 中国当局在周日发布的最新消息中称，已有 16 人死亡、546 人失踪。 灾难发生后的最初 72 小时被视为对救援行动至关重要，而找到失踪人员生还的希望也越来越渺茫。 尽管如此，救援工作仍在继续，但由于地形复杂、洪水持续高涨和恶劣的天气而变得复杂。 上周三发生了毁灭性的洪水，当时喜马拉雅山的一大片冰川松动，坠落到尼泊尔朗唐国家公园的谷底，释放出一道巨大的水墙和泥浆，冲入河流和山谷。 由此引发的洪水摧毁了村庄并摧毁了发电站、道路和桥梁等重要基础设施。 目前，救援工作主要集中在寻找大约 900 名失踪的水电工人，其中数百人可能被困在尼泊尔 12 个水电项目的隧道和地下区域中。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特周一对路透社表示：“大量碎片已经堆积起来，这给我们打开隧道带来了巨大挑战。” 正如我的同事在这篇报道中指出的那样，上特里苏里水电站项目周末约有 250 人获救，陆军工程师开始在现场进行爆破作业，营救另外 42 名被认为失踪的工人。 担心许多人仍然被困在流经尼泊尔中部的特里苏里河沿岸水电站的庞大泥浆隧道网络中。

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet have brought immense loss, with over a thousand lives tragically ended and thousands more missing. In the face of such profound grief and destruction, we look to the promise of a future where suffering and death will be no more. May Yahweh comfort those who mourn and grant them His peace.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏地区毁灭性的洪水带来了巨大的损失，超过一千条生命不幸终结，另有数千人失踪。面对如此深切的悲痛和毁灭，我们寄望于一个不再有痛苦和死亡的未来。愿雅伟安慰那些哀恸的人，并赐予他们平安。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Meet the magical creatures inspired by shamanism, folklore … and an old Ikea bag
title.zh: 遇见受萨满教、民间传说……和旧宜家袋启发的魔法生物

summary.en: Korean-Chinese artist Woo Jin Joo uses London's discarded materials to create playful art, including ceramic goblin feet and furry disembodied legs, drawing inspiration from Korean myths, philosophy, and embroidery.
summary.zh: 韩裔中国艺术家Woo Jin Joo利用伦敦的废弃材料创作充满玩趣的艺术品，包括陶瓷哥布林脚和毛茸茸的无肢腿，其灵感来源于韩国神话、哲学和刺绣。

body.en: From ceramic goblin feet to furry disembodied legs, Korean-Chinese artist Woo Jin Joo is using London junk to inject the art world with a spirit of playfulness Woo Jin Joo’s studio is full of magic. Ceramic green goblin feet line the windowsill, disembodied furry legs jut out of one white wall and, on the table behind where the Korean-Chinese artist sits drinking tea, a headless being dressed in a black coat squats, arms aloft in warning. There are also neat racks of colourful thread next to a freehand embroidery machine, the source of this supernatural hoard. This is where Joo creates much of her art – surface embroideries and sculptural 3D creatures inspired by Korean myth, philosophy and the relationship between humans and the natural world. Continue reading...
body.zh: 从陶瓷妖精脚到毛茸茸的无实体腿，韩裔中国艺术家吴金珠利用伦敦垃圾为艺术世界注入了一种俏皮的精神。吴金珠的工作室充满了魔力。窗台上排列着绿色的陶瓷脚，毛茸茸的腿从白墙上伸出来，韩裔中国艺术家坐在后面喝茶的桌子上，蹲着一个穿着黑色外套的无头人，高举双臂发出警告。徒手刺绣机旁边还有整齐的彩色线架，这是这些超自然宝藏的来源。这是 Joo 创作大部分艺术作品的地方——表面刺绣和雕塑 3D 生物，其灵感来自韩国神话、哲学以及人类与自然世界的关系。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Woo Jin Joo transforms discarded items into whimsical creatures, infusing her art with spirit and playfulness. Her dedication to her craft, whether through embroidery or sculpture, echoes the call to do all work heartily, as for Yahweh, finding dignity and purpose in the act of creation itself. This artistic endeavor reminds us that even in the mundane or...
reflection.zh: Woo Jin Joo将废弃物品转化为异想天开的生物，为她的艺术注入精神和玩趣。她对工艺的投入，无论是刺绣还是雕塑，都呼应着要全心全意地去做一切工作，如同为主而做，在创造本身的行为中找到尊严和目标。 这项艺术事业提醒我们，即使在平凡或被丢弃的事物中，也蕴藏着美丽和意义的潜力。通过将精力倾注于改造这些材料，Woo Jin...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: As glaciers melt, can communities be protected?
title.zh: 冰川融化，社区能否得到保护？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 气温上升增加了山区洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案，以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士巴滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，当时几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪爆发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员 Levan Tielidze 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩石斜坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯联邦北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪崩塌和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽告诉德国之声：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（36 华氏度），与 2020 年的水平相比，更广泛的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖面积可能会减少多达一半……

reflection.en: The news from Nepal and Tibet paints a stark picture of creation groaning under the weight of climate change. Glaciers, formed over millennia, are becoming unstable, leading to devastating 'mountain tsunamis.' This echoes Romans 8:22, which speaks of all creation groaning in the pains of childbirth, awaiting its redemption from decay. The urgent need for...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔和西藏的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的景象：在气候变化的重压下，受造界发出痛苦的呻吟。历经千年形成的冰川正变得不稳定，导致毁灭性的“山洪海啸”。这呼应了罗马书8:22所说，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦直到如今，等待着从败坏中得释放。对解决方案的迫切需求，凸显了我们共同的责任，要关爱这个脆弱的世界。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: The final minutes before floodwater crashed through Nepal-China border
title.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉偏远尼泊尔-中国边境口岸灾难性山洪暴发的经过

summary.en: More than 100 Indians are missing at a vital Nepal-China trade crossing after devastating Himalayan floods.
summary.zh: 在喜马拉雅山毁灭性的洪水之后，一个重要的尼泊尔-中国贸易过境点有超过100名印度人失踪。

body.en:
A dark wall appears from behind the buildings at Gyirong, on the Chinese side of the Nepal-Tibet border. At first, it looks almost like a black cloud. Then it gathers shape and speed: water, mud, boulders, ice and rock surging down the valley. The CCTV footage, whose timestamp reads 10:59:53, went viral.

For many, it was the first visual evidence of the sheer scale of the destruction that was unfolding.

What happened in the minutes that followed is still difficult to reconstruct. But fragments of video and satellite imagery show much of the border complex swept away, with buildings that once crowded the valley floor simply gone.

Electronic immigration records from Nepal's Rasuwagadhi border post are filling some gaps, as well as insights from its only surviving staff member. Tika Ram Pokharel, who happened to be in Kathmandu sitting an exam on the day, tells the BBC the crossing was unusually busy when floodwater hit.

"This is a historic travel route between Kathmandu and Tibet," explains Kathmandu-based hydrologist Ajay Dixit. "The area is geologically vulnerable, characterised by deep gorges and steep rivers that flow at high velocity, carry heavy sediment and can bring down huge boulders."

It is a place where pilgrims heading towards Mount Kailash cross paths with traders travelling between Nepal and China, truck drivers, customs officials, tourists and people who live along the border.

On the morning of the flood, more than 100 Indians may have been in or around the crossing. At least 275 Indians remain missing in Nepal, according to India's foreign ministry.

Nepal's immigration department has been trying to reconstruct who passed through Rasuwagadhi in the final hours before the disaster.

Electronic records show that 89 Nepali and foreign nationals had cleared immigration to leave Nepal for Tibet, while four people had registered their entry into Nepal.

The immigration system recorded its final transaction at 08:35:03 local time (10:52 Tibet time), less than 10 minutes before the torrent appeared on the CCTV footage at Gyirong.

Four immigration employees, including the head of the Rasuwagadhi office, went missing in the floods. His body was later recovered far downstream. The female official who recorded the final transactions is still missing.

Among the foreign nationals recorded leaving Nepal that morning were 32 Indians, 12 Chinese nationals and nine Americans, as well as citizens of Britain, Canada, Australia and Italy.

Tika Ram Pokharel, the surviving senior immigration assistant at Rasuwagadhi, says the electronic records capture only part of what was happening at the border that morning.

The immigration office stood at Ghatte Khola Bazar, about 1.5km north of Timure, a small trading settlement clustered around the crossing....
body.zh: 吉隆位于尼泊尔和西藏边境的中国一侧，建筑物后面出现了一堵黑墙。起初，它看起来几乎像一朵乌云。然后它的形状和速度都聚集起来：水、泥土、巨石、冰和岩石沿着山谷汹涌而下。闭路电视录像上的时间戳显示当地时间 10:59:53。 接下来几分钟发生的事情仍然很难重现。但灾难前后的视频和卫星图像片段已经开始揭示破坏的规模。边境建筑群的大部分似乎已被冲走，曾经拥挤在谷底的建筑物完全消失了。 吉隆是8月26日席卷该地区的洪水所摧毁的地方之一。 就在边境另一边，尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区的拉苏瓦加迪也遭受了广泛破坏。连接尼泊尔和中国的友谊大桥以及尼泊尔的移民和海关设施被冲毁。蒂穆尔（Timure）是一个聚集在过境点周围的小型贸易定居点，遭到了破坏。 加德满都水文学家阿贾伊·迪克西特 (Ajay Dixit) 表示：“这是加德满都和西藏之间的一条历史悠久的旅行路线。该地区地质脆弱，其特点是峡谷深邃，河流陡峭，流速快，携带大量沉积物，可能会冲落巨大的巨石。” 这条路线仍然是尼泊尔和中国之间的重要门户。在这里，前往冈仁波齐峰的朝圣者与往返于尼泊尔和中国之间的商人、卡车司机、海关官员、游客和边境居民相遇。 洪水发生当天早上，过境点内或周围可能有 100 多名印第安人。据印度外交部称，至少有 275 名印度人在尼泊尔失踪。 尼泊尔移民局一直在努力重建灾难发生前最后几个小时内经过拉苏瓦加迪的人员情况。 电子记录显示，89名尼泊尔人和外国人已办理离开尼泊尔前往西藏的出入境手续，另有4人已登记进入尼泊尔。 出入境系统在当地时间上午 8:35:03（西藏时间上午 10:52）记录了最终交易，距离吉隆闭路电视录像中出现洪流不到 10 分钟。 包括拉苏瓦加迪办公室负责人在内的四名移民雇员在洪水中失踪。他的尸体后来在下游很远的地方被发现。记录最终交易的女官员仍然下落不明。 当天早上离开尼泊尔的外国人中有 32 名印度人、12 名中国人和 9 名美国人，以及英国、加拿大、澳大利亚和意大利公民。 拉苏瓦加迪 (Rasuwagadhi) 的高级移民助理蒂卡·拉姆·波卡雷尔 (Tika Ram Pokharel) 是其办公室中唯一已知幸存的成员。他有...

reflection.en: The news from Nepal describes a "dark wall" of water, mud, and debris surging down the valley, a stark image of nature's destructive power. The Bible speaks of all creation groaning, awaiting its redemption from decay and ruin. This event, like so many natural disasters, is a painful reminder of our world's fragility and the deep impact of the fall on the...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔的新闻描述了“一道黑色的墙”——水、泥和瓦砾——汹涌而下，这是大自然毁灭力量的鲜明写照。《圣经》提到，万物都在一同叹息，劳苦直到如今，等待着脱离败坏的辖制。这次事件，以及许多其他自然灾害，都痛苦地提醒我们这个世界的脆弱，以及堕落对自然秩序造成的深刻影响。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Albanese responds after China warns of 'consequences' over Taiwan at Pacific summit
title.zh: 中国警告台湾出席太平洋岛国论坛将带来“后果”

summary.en: China's top diplomat for Pacific Island Countries, Qian Bo, has warned of 'consequences' regarding Taiwan's presence as a development partner at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau. He expressed China's 'serious concerns' and called Taiwan's participation 'inappropriate,' though he denied...
summary.zh: 中国太平洋岛国事务特使钱波警告，台湾作为太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议的发展伙伴出席将带来“后果”。他表达了中国“严重关切”，并称台湾的参与“不恰当”，但他否认其言论是威胁。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has stopped short of criticising China over threats of "consequences" for Taiwan's attendance at an annual Pacific summit, saying the forum decides who takes part.

Albanese's comments follow a warning from China's top Pacific Islands diplomat, who said "there will always be consequences" for Taiwan's strong presence at the annual Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) leaders' meeting in Palau, with the highly charged three-day talks officially starting on Tuesday.

Albanese said he was "not distracted" when asked if Taiwan's presence was a distraction. Asked if he thought it was appropriate for China to make threats, the prime minister said: "The Pacific Islands Forum determines what happens here, not any other country."

Earlier, China's special envoy for Pacific Island affairs, Qian Bo, denied his comments were a threat, but said China has "serious concerns" about Taiwan's status as a development partner at the forum.

"There will always be consequences. You know, this is objected to by all, so this should not have happened. We think it's very inappropriate to do so," he told Australian reporters while leaving the forum's opening ceremony on Monday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Taiwan, a self-governing democracy, broke away from mainland China in 1949. Beijing views it as Chinese territory that must be brought under its control by force if necessary .

Like the United States, Australia recognises and has formal ties with China, but maintains unofficial ties with Taiwan.

Neither China nor Taiwan are part of the 18-member group at the forum, but countries including the United States and China have traditionally been invited as dialogue partners. Taiwan has been categorised as a development partner since 1993 and is being represented this year by foreign minister Lin Chia-lung, along with a sizeable delegation.

Palau is one of only three Pacific nations to have diplomatic relations with Taiwan, which has created great friction between the hosts and China over the past decade. In 2017, China placed de facto "tourist bans" on the tiny Micronesian country, which received 40 per cent of its GDP from the tourism industry, in an apparent attempt to sway Palau's diplomatic position away from Taiwan.

Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr said on Sunday he was aware there would be "threats" of retaliation if Taiwan attended this year's talks.

"Let's not use this as a place that we should be threatening or making people feel uncomfortable," he told reporters.

"China doesn't tell us that we cannot be a partner to Taiwan. That is our sovereign decision, not their decision."

Qian also claimed China has the "understanding and...
body.zh: 中国太平洋岛国最高外交官警告说，台湾在帕劳举行的太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）年度领导人会议上的强势参与“总会产生后果”，拉开了周二正式开始的为期三天的高度紧张的会谈。 北京太平洋岛国事务特使钱波否认他的言论构成威胁，但表示中国对台湾在论坛上作为发展伙伴的地位“严重关切”。 “总会有后果的。你知道，这是所有人都反对的，所以这不应该发生。我们认为这样做是非常不合适的，”他在周一离开开幕式时告诉澳大利亚记者。 中国和台湾都不属于该论坛的 18 个成员国，但美国和中国等国家历来被邀请作为对话伙伴。台湾自1993年起就被列为发展伙伴，今年由外交部长林家龙率领一个规模庞大的代表团出席。 帕劳是仅有的三个与台湾建交的太平洋国家之一，过去十年来，东道主与中国之间产生了巨大摩擦。 2017年，北京对这个密克罗尼西亚小国实施了事实上的“旅游禁令”，该国GDP的40%来自旅游业，显然是试图动摇帕劳的外交立场，使其远离台北。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 帕劳总统小苏兰吉尔·惠普斯周日表示，他知道如果台湾参加今年的会谈，将会有“报复威胁”。 他对记者说：“我们不要把这里当作我们应该威胁或让人们感到不舒服的地方。” “中国没有告诉我们，我们不能成为台湾的合作伙伴。这是我们的主权决定，而不是他们的决定。” 钱其琛还声称，中国得到了PIF“大多数”成员国的“理解和支持”，并向帕劳“非常明确”地表明了自己的立场。 今年的PIF在正式开始前就陷入了争议，六位领导人被确认缺席，其中包括即将离任的论坛主席、所罗门群岛总理马修·韦尔，以及基里巴斯亲北京总统塔内蒂·马毛，后者特意派了前驻华大使大卫·蒂博代替。 他们缺席的原因包括国家议会职责和健康问题，威尔士已抵达科罗尔，并被迫在周末返回家乡，以应对可能的领导挑战。但缺席的关键领导人让人怀疑，在为期三天的活动中，是否可以就关键议程项目（包括气候行动）采取有意义的集体行动……

reflection.en: As leaders gather in Palau for the Pacific Islands Forum, diplomatic tensions simmer. China's envoy has voiced strong objections to Taiwan's participation, warning of 'consequences.' In such moments of heightened political friction, the call to pursue peace and seek diplomatic solutions, even amidst disagreement, remains paramount.
reflection.zh: 在太平洋岛国论坛领导人在帕劳举行会议之际，外交紧张局势悄然升温。中国特使对台湾的参与表达了强烈反对，并警告将有“后果”。在政治摩擦加剧的时刻，即使存在分歧，寻求和平与外交解决方案的呼吁仍然至关重要。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Japan Inc is betting big on India as China risks deepen
title.zh: 日本企业押注印度，以应对中国风险加剧

summary.en: Japanese companies are increasing their investments in India due to a shrinking domestic market and growing risks associated with China. This trend is evident in the expanding presence of Japanese consumer brands across India, with both established and niche players setting up operations.
summary.zh: 由于国内市场萎缩以及与中国相关的风险加剧，日本公司正在加大对印度的投资。这种趋势在日本消费品牌日益增长的印度业务中显而易见，无论是知名品牌还是小众品牌都在印度设立业务。

body.en:
India's commerce minister Piyush Goyal led the country's largest-ever business delegation to Japan last week in a bid to expand trade and investment ties between the two countries. His visit came as Japan's deepening push into Asia's third largest economy has become increasingly more apparent.

If you visit a shopping mall or a high street in Mumbai, Delhi or Bengaluru, it's hard to miss the growing number of Japanese consumer brands that have set up shop across India.

Apparel giants Uniqlo and Muji and premium sneakers company Onitsuka Tiger have been around for a while, but are rapidly expanding.

Niche players are also here - Nitori, a Japanese furniture maker, entered the market recently, while convenience store chain Lawson , external is on its way, with a plan to reportedly open 10,000 stores by 2050 in India, starting with Mumbai.

It's not just retail. At a time when foreign lenders have been exiting their Indian bank portfolios, Japanese banks are aggressively bidding for Indian financial assets.

MUFG Bank - Japan's largest bank - closed a deal to buy 20% of Indian shadow lender Shriram Finance for $4.4bn last year in what was the biggest ever foreign investment in India's financial sector.

Last year also saw Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) becoming the largest shareholder in India's Yes Bank with a 24.22% stake.

Japan Inc is now the largest contributor to India's booming ecosystem of global capability centres (GCCs) in the Asia Pacific.

More than 100 Japanese firms operate these GCCs in the country, according to a recent Deloitte report , external . GCCs are offshore innovation hubs of multinationals that perform business critical functions such as R&D, corporate strategy and artificial intelligence development among a plethora of other key jobs.

"Japanese companies are having to look to India for growth. With the local population declining for the past 16-17 years there isn't just a slowdown in domestic demand, but a permanent shrinking of the market," Vipul Nath Jindal, Founder of Next Bharat Ventures, an impact fund backed by Suzuki Motor Corporation, which recently announced a $200m fund in India, told the BBC.

At the same time, Japan's traditional markets for expansion have become increasingly less attractive, he says.

"Investment into China has fallen sharply amid geopolitical tensions and changing economic dynamics, the US market is more challenging because of tariffs and domestic competition, and the market size of other Southeast Asian economies is limited."

Against this backdrop, India has become a natural target market for Japanese companies to drive long-term business growth.

Economic ties between the countries gathered pace at a government-to-government level when they signed an agreement to liberalise...
body.zh: 印度商务部长皮尤什·戈亚尔上周率领该国有史以来规模最大的商业代表团访问日本，以扩大两国之间的贸易和投资关系。他此访之际，日本深化进军亚洲第三大经济体的步伐日益明显。 如果您参观孟买、德里或班加罗尔的购物中心或大街，很难错过越来越多在​​印度各地开设商店的日本消费品牌。 服装巨头优衣库和无印良品以及高端运动鞋公司鬼冢虎已经存在了一段时间，但正在迅速扩张。 利基市场参与者也在这里——日本家具制造商 Nitori 最近进入了市场，而外部连锁便利店 Lawson 也在路上，据报道计划到 2050 年在印度开设 10,000 家商店，从孟买开始。 这不仅仅是零售。在外国银行纷纷退出印度银行投资组合之际，日本银行却在积极竞购印度金融资产。 日本最大的银行三菱日联银行 (MUFG Bank) 去年完成了以 44 亿美元收购印度影子银行 Shriram Finance 20% 股份的交易，这是印度金融领域有史以来最大的一笔外国投资。 去年，三井住友银行（SMBC）还成为印度Yes Bank的最大股东，持股24.22%。 日本公司现在是印度在亚太地区蓬勃发展的全球能力中心（GCC）生态系统的最大贡献者。 根据德勤最近的一份外部报告，有 100 多家日本公司在该国经营这些海湾合作委员会。海湾合作委员会是跨国公司的离岸创新中心，履行关键业务职能，例如研发、企业战略和人工智能开发以及众多其他关键工作。 Next Bharat Ventures 的创始人 Vipul Nath Jindal 向 BBC 表示：“日本企业不得不将目光投向印度寻求增长。过去 16-17 年当地人口不断减少，这不仅导致国内需求放缓，而且导致市场永久性萎缩。”Next Bharat Ventures 是一家由铃木汽车公司支持的影响力基金，该公司最近宣布在印度设立 2 亿美元的基金。 他表示，与此同时，日本传统的扩张市场的吸引力已变得越来越低。 “由于地缘政治紧张和经济动态变化，对中国的投资大幅下降，美国市场因关税和国内竞争而更具挑战性，而其他东南亚经济体的市场规模有限。” 在此背景下，印度自然成为日本企业推动业务长期增长的目标市场。 当两国签署自由化协议时，两国之间的经济联系在政府间层面上加快了步伐……

reflection.en: As Japanese businesses strategically shift their focus and resources towards India, they are embarking on a path of significant expansion. This move highlights a deliberate effort to navigate geopolitical and economic uncertainties by diversifying their investments. The principle of committing one's plans to divine guidance offers a framework for seeking...
reflection.zh: 随着日本企业战略性地将重心和资源转向印度，它们正踏上一条大规模扩张的道路。此举凸显了通过多元化投资来应对地缘政治和经济不确定性的深思熟虑的努力。《雅伟》的原则为在如此大规模的商业活动中寻求智慧和祝福提供了一个框架。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: 'Hoping for a miracle': Family of missing Australian in Nepal speaks
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾死亡人数超950人，救援人员争分夺秒营救被困隧道工人

summary.en: Rescuers are urgently working to free hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were inundated by mud from catastrophic flooding along the Nepal-China border. The combined death toll in Nepal and China has surpassed 950, with over 4400 people missing. At least 900 workers are unaccounted for at...
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-中国边境发生灾难性洪水后，救援人员正争分夺秒地营救被埋在水电站隧道中的数百名工人。尼泊尔和中国的合计死亡人数已超过950人，另有超过4400人失踪。受洪水影响的12个水电项目至少有900名工人下落不明。

body.en:
The Australian government has confirmed two Australians have been safely located amid catastrophic flooding on the Nepal-China border as the number of people killed climbs and increasingly desperate families search for missing loved ones.

The combined deaths in Nepal and China surpassed 1,000, with more than 4,400 people — including 42 Australians — missing.

In a statement, his family said he had been visiting Mount Kailash on a pilgrimage trek when the floods hit. He went missing shortly after making contact at the Gyirong Port border crossing.

"Luke is an extremely strong, compassionate, disciplined and spiritual person," the statement said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Once he makes a decision, he commits to it fully and he was so excited to be visiting Mount Kailash.

"We can do nothing but continue hoping for a miracle that Luke, and the others who remain missing, are found alive and well."

Officials were in contact on Tuesday with an Australian in Tibet, after another Australian, Cara Severino, was located safely on the weekend.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong said she was "incredibly thankful" a second Australian has been found, whose identity the government did not confirm.

"It’s hard to imagine the sense of relief their loved ones must be feeling after what will have been an incredibly harrowing few days," Wong said in a statement.

"Despite this second piece of welcome news in recent days, we must remain realistic about the days ahead .... the conditions facing search and recovery teams are extremely challenging."

Nepal's disaster agency said 987 deaths had been counted there, while Chinese authorities reported 16 deaths in their most recent update on Sunday.

Rescuers are racing to free hundreds of workers believed to be trapped in tunnels at hydropower sites that were buried in mud by the flooding.

A private-sector association representing power companies said at least 900 workers were unaccounted for at 12 hydropower projects damaged by the flash floods in Nepal's Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts.

At least one expert said that some workers could have access to oxygen, but others warned that the chances of finding survivors were diminishing.

As the rescue efforts intensified, four bodies were recovered from three mud-filled tunnels, Nepal's army said.

Some workers managed to call for help when the disaster struck last Wednesday, and others who managed to flee reported to authorities and relatives that many of their colleagues were still in the tunnels, said Mohan Kumar Dangi, president of the Independent Power Producers' Association.

It was unclear whether rescuers have had any contact with the trapped...
body.zh: 随着死亡人数不断攀升，以及越来越绝望的家庭寻找失踪亲人，救援人员正在竞相营救数百名据信被困在水电站隧道中的工人，这些工人因尼泊尔和中国边境的灾难性洪水而被埋在泥土中。 尼泊尔和中国的死亡人数合计超过 950 人，超过 4400 人失踪，其中包括 43 名澳大利亚人。 代表电力公司的私营部门协会表示，尼泊尔拉苏瓦和努瓦科特地区因山洪爆发而受损的 12 个水电项目中，至少有 900 名工人下落不明。 至少一位专家表示，一些工人可以获得氧气，但其他专家警告说，找到幸存者的机会正在减少。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 尼泊尔军方表示，随着救援工作的加强，从三个充满泥浆的隧道中找到了四具尸体。 独立电力生产商协会主席莫汉·库马尔·丹吉(Mohan Kumar Dangi)表示，上周三灾难发生时，一些工人设法寻求帮助，其他设法逃离的工人向当局和亲属报告，他们的许多同事仍在隧道里。 目前还不清楚自最初发出求救信号以来，救援人员是否与被困工人有过任何接触。 丹吉说，灾难发生六天后，人们越来越担心有些人可能会窒息而死。 救援工作的重点是被困在为控制水流而建造的巨大隧道中的人们。 “这些隧道足够大，可以让卡车通过，”位于孟加拉国达卡的奥地利格拉茨大学的地球科学家雅各布·施泰纳说。 “据我们了解，他们已经设法为一些被困在里面的人提供氧气，并正在努力营救他们。不过，这是一场时间竞赛，因为人们需要食物和水。” Dangi 说，在受灾最严重的 Rasuwa 地区的 Upper Trishuli-1 水电站项目中，至少有 576 人失踪，并补充说，其中约 300 人据信被困在该项目的隧道内。 尼泊尔陆军发言人 Raja Ram Basnet 准将表示，在 Trishuli-3 水电项目中，工作人员正在努力下潜到隧道内约 15 米处，以营救被困在隧道内的人员。 尼泊尔达丁一座遭受洪水破坏的发电站的工人们正在铲泥，他们表示，该发电站是为该地区 2 万多人提供电力的关键线路。 中方的救援和恢复工作包括重建通往吉隆口岸的道路，该口岸负责控制中尼之间的交通。 当工人们试图重新铺设道路时，卡车运载着巨大的岩石。

reflection.en: The news from the Nepal-China border is grim, with hundreds of workers trapped in tunnels following catastrophic floods. In such moments, the cry of the vulnerable echoes, reminding us of the biblical call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves. May we be moved to advocate for the safety and rescue of these individuals, reflecting the compassion...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-中国边境传来的消息令人心痛，数百名工人在灾难性的洪水后被困于隧道之中。在这样的时刻，弱者的呼喊回响，提醒我们圣经呼召我们要为那些无法为自己发声的人说话。愿我们被触动，为这些人的安全和救援而倡导，体现《箴言》31:8-9所敦促我们的怜悯之心。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水画面

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场夺走生命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后紧随而来的是一场数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则用官方内容充斥了各大平台。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The story highlights how visual evidence of a devastating flood in Tibet was quickly erased by censors, silencing the suffering of affected communities. This act of suppression leaves the voiceless unheard, a stark contrast to the biblical call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves and to ensure their suffering is not ignored.
reflection.zh: 这篇报道揭示了西藏一场毁灭性洪水的视觉证据如何被审查人员迅速抹去，从而压制了受灾社区的苦难之声。这种压制行为使得无声者无法被听见，与圣经中呼吁为不能言语者说话、确保他们的苦难不被忽视的教导形成了鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Nepal flood relief vehicles trapped as heavy rain turns roads to mud
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾救援车辆因暴雨泥泞受阻

summary.en: Heavy rain has hampered relief efforts in Nepal where thousands remain missing after flash floods hit its border with Tibet.
summary.zh: 连日暴雨严重阻碍了尼泊尔的救援工作，此前该国与西藏边境地区发生了山洪灾害，导致数千人失踪。

reflection.en: In Nepal, the vital work of delivering aid is stalled by relentless rain, turning roads into impassable mud. This situation underscores the urgent need for practical compassion, as described in Isaiah 58:7, which calls us to share our food with the hungry and provide shelter for the displaced. Even when physical barriers arise, the spirit of helping those...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔，倾盆大雨将道路变成泥泞，阻碍了至关重要的救援物资运送。这一困境凸显了《以赛亚书》58章7节所呼吁的切实怜悯：要将食物分给饥饿的人，将无家可归的人接到家中。即使面临实际的障碍，帮助那些急需援助之人的心意，仍是信仰的深刻体现。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: Sydney’s beaches enter the drone age to get swimmers back in the water after spate of shark attacks
title.zh: 悉尼海滩进入无人机时代，以应对鲨鱼袭击事件，让游泳者重返水中

summary.en: Seventy beaches across New South Wales are part of a $34 million drone monitoring program, operating from dawn till dusk, which an expert has described as 'the best technology we have at the moment' to enhance swimmer safety following a series of shark attacks.
summary.zh: 新南威尔士州有七十个海滩参与了耗资3400万美元的无人机监测计划，该计划从黎明到黄昏运行，一位专家称其为“目前我们拥有的最佳技术”，旨在提高游泳者在发生一系列鲨鱼袭击事件后的安全。

reflection.en: Faced with the fear and danger of shark attacks, authorities are deploying advanced drone technology to monitor beaches. This pursuit of knowledge and innovative solutions reflects a deep human desire to understand and mitigate risks, seeking safety through diligent observation and technological advancement.
reflection.zh: 面对鲨鱼袭击的恐惧和危险，当局正在部署先进的无人机技术来监测海滩。这种对知识和创新解决方案的追求，反映了人类深刻地理解和减轻风险的愿望，通过勤奋的观察和技术进步来寻求安全。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.

title.en: NSW government to resume pill testing at music festivals but rejects calls for wider community rollout
title.zh: 新南威尔士州政府将在音乐节恢复验毒服务，但拒绝在社区推广

summary.en: The New South Wales government will reintroduce pill testing at music festivals starting in October, but has rejected calls for a wider community rollout. While NSW Health will consult with the festival industry and harm reduction groups to implement testing at up to 15 festivals annually, the controversial use of...
summary.zh: 新南威尔士州政府将从10月起在音乐节恢复验毒服务，但拒绝了在社区更广泛推广的呼吁。虽然新南威尔士州卫生部门将与音乐节行业和减害组织协商，每年在多达15个音乐节上实施验毒服务，但备受争议的警犬搜查措施将继续存在。健康和减害倡导者认为，这些措施可能导致更危险的吸毒行为。

body.en: Use of sniffer dogs and searches will continue despite health and harm reduction groups arguing they could lead to riskier drug taking Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Drug testing will resume at New South Wales music festivals from October, but will not be rolled out into the wider community despite calls from peak health and harm reduction groups, while the controversial use of sniffer dogs and searches will continue. reflection.en: The NSW government's decision to resume pill testing at music festivals, while maintaining sniffer dog searches, highlights the difficult balance between public health and law enforcement. This approach seeks to mitigate harm, acknowledging the reality of drug use, yet it continues measures that some argue may increase risks. It prompts reflection on how to...

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in Macquarie University's use of a "Virtual Peer" chatbot, echoes the prophecy that in the end times, "knowledge will increase." While AI offers new tools for learning, it also raises questions about the human element in education and the potential for job displacement. We are called to navigate...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如麦格理大学使用“虚拟伙伴”聊天机器人所示，呼应了但以理的预言——末世“知识必增长”。虽然人工智能为学习提供了新工具，但它也引发了关于教育中人际互动以及潜在失业的问题。我们蒙召要以智慧来应对这些变化，确保科技服务于人类的繁荣，而非削弱它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: House prices head for historic 10% drop as fourth interest rate hike looms

body.en: Cotality data reveals property prices are now falling in more than 90% of Australian suburbs, while analysts expect market downturn to continue Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The prospect of the steepest property market downturn in history will not stop the Reserve Bank from delivering a fourth interest rate hike as it battles to bring inflation back under control , economists say. Continue reading...

reflection.zh: 随着利率攀升，许多家庭面临债务奴役的前景，这一困境在箴言书中得到了生动的描述。这种经济压力影响了澳大利亚90%以上的郊区，凸显了那些陷入借贷循环中人们的脆弱性。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

title.en: Who can still get a free COVID vaccine? Australia's new rules explained
title.zh: 谁仍能免费接种 COVID 疫苗？澳大利亚新规解读

summary.en: As COVID vaccine access changes, experts warn against drawing the wrong conclusion. From 1 October, free COVID-19 vaccines will be limited to those most at risk of severe disease, a move that some experts believe could leave certain vulnerable populations unprotected.
summary.zh: 随着 COVID 疫苗接种政策的改变，专家警告不要得出错误的结论。从 10 月 1 日起，免费的 COVID-19 疫苗将仅限于那些最有可能患重症的人群，一些专家认为此举可能会让某些弱势群体面临风险。

body.en:
Australia is preparing to wind back its universal COVID-19 vaccination program, but experts warn the change shouldn't be interpreted as a sign the virus is no longer a public health concern.

From 1 October, the National COVID-19 Vaccine Program will transition into the National Immunisation Program (NIP), with free COVID-19 vaccines becoming limited to people considered most at risk of severe disease.

But professor Adrian Esterman, chair of biostatistics and epidemiology at the University of Adelaide, said the new eligibility rules could leave some people vulnerable.

"There are lots and lots of people with diabetes, with other chronic conditions, autoimmune conditions, that would be hundreds of thousands of people who were getting a free shot and aren't getting one now," Esterman said.

The change comes as the latest federal government surveillance data shows COVID-19 cases increased over the past fortnight.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However, experts say 2026 has been unusual, with Australia yet to experience the clear winter COVID peak seen in previous years.

SBS News has contacted the Department of Health for comment, but it previously told the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners that COVID-19 is now endemic in Australia and that vaccination policy should focus on maintaining protection among those most vulnerable to severe disease.

From 1 October, free COVID-19 vaccination under the NIP will be available to adults aged 75 and over every six months, and adults aged 65 to 74 every 12 months.

Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people aged 50 to 74 will also remain eligible for an annual dose, as will adults aged 18 and over who are severely immunocompromised.

People outside those groups will still be able to access COVID-19 vaccines, but may have to pay for them.

Catherine Bennett, chair of Epidemiology at Deakin University, said the change should be viewed alongside Australia's broader vaccination program.

She said COVID-19 was now behaving differently from earlier in the pandemic, with population immunity helping to reduce severe illness.

"It's important that this is actually now being taken into a national immunisation program because that means that we have a sustained commitment to COVID alongside the other respiratory diseases," Bennett said.

She told SBS News that the lower vaccination rates among healthy adults had not translated into a comparable increase in severe disease.

Esterman said a bigger concern was whether Australians who most need protection were actually taking up the vaccines already available to them.

He said just 25 per cent of people aged 75 and over had received a COVID-19 vaccine in...
body.zh: 澳大利亚正准备取消其通用的 COVID-19 疫苗接种计划，但专家警告称，这一变化不应被解释为该病毒不再是公共卫生问题的迹象。 从 10 月 1 日起，国家 COVID-19 疫苗计划将转变为国家免疫计划 (NIP)，免费的 COVID-19 疫苗仅限于被认为最有可能罹患严重疾病的人群。 但阿德莱德大学生物统计学和流行病学系主任阿德里安·埃斯特曼教授表示，新的资格规则可能会让一些人变得脆弱。 埃斯特曼说：“有很多很多人患有糖尿病、其他慢性病、自身免疫性疾病，这将有数十万人原本可以免费注射，但现在却没有注射。” 这一变化发生之际，最新的联邦政府监测数据显示，过去两周 COVID-19 病例有所增加。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，专家表示，2026 年是不同寻常的一年，澳大利亚尚未经历前几年出现的明显冬季新冠疫情高峰。 SBS 新闻已联系卫生部征求意见，但该部门此前曾告诉澳大利亚皇家全科医生学院，COVID-19 目前在澳大利亚流行，疫苗接种政策应侧重于维持对最易患严重疾病的人群的保护。 从 10 月 1 日起，根据 NIP，75 岁及以上的成年人每六个月可免费接种一次新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 疫苗，65 岁至 74 岁的成年人每 12 个月可免费接种一次新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 疫苗。 50 岁至 74 岁的原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民以及 18 岁及以上免疫功能严重低下的成年人也将有资格每年接种一次疫苗。 这些群体之外的人仍然能够获得 COVID-19 疫苗，但可能需要付费。 迪肯大学流行病学系主任凯瑟琳·贝内特表示，这一变化应与澳大利亚更广泛的疫苗接种计划一起看待。 她说，COVID-19 现在的表现与大流行早期不同，人群免疫力有助于减少严重疾病。 贝内特说：“重要的是，现在实际上已将其纳入国家免疫计划，因为这意味着我们对新冠病毒和其他呼吸道疾病有持续的承诺。” 她告诉 SBS 新闻，健康成年人的疫苗接种率较低并没有转化为严重疾病的相应增加。 埃斯特曼说，更令人担忧的是最需要保护的澳大利亚人是否真的接种了他们已经可以获得的疫苗。 他说，75 岁及以上的人中只有 25% 接种了 COVID-19 疫苗……

reflection.en: Australia's shift in COVID vaccine accessibility underscores the critical need for wise counsel in public health policy. Experts caution that limiting free access could inadvertently leave vulnerable groups exposed, reminding us that thoughtful deliberation and expert advice are essential when making decisions that impact community well-being.
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚在 COVID 疫苗接种可及性方面的转变，凸显了公共卫生政策中明智咨询的关键必要性。专家们警告说，限制免费接种可能会无意中使弱势群体暴露于风险之中，这提醒我们，在做出影响社区福祉的决定时，深思熟虑和专家建议至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: SBS confirmed as Australia's home of the 2030 FIFA World Cup
title.zh: SBS确认成为2030年国际足联世界杯在澳大利亚的转播平台

summary.en: SBS has secured exclusive national rights to broadcast the FIFA World Cup 2030, promising live and free access to all 104 matches for football fans across Australia via television, video, and radio.
summary.zh: SBS已获得2030年国际足联世界杯的独家全国转播权，承诺通过电视、视频和广播为澳大利亚各地的足球迷提供所有104场比赛的免费直播。

body.en:
SBS has cemented its place as Australia’s spiritual home of football, securing exclusive national rights to the FIFA World Cup 2030.

Football-loving Australians will have access to all 104 matches of the 2030 tournament via SBS television, video and radio programming.

SBS managing director Jane Palfreyman said the broadcaster is "without question" Australia’s home of the World Cup.

"The FIFA World Cup is one of the few sporting events that truly brings Australians together across all cultures, languages and communities," she said.

"In 2030 audiences will once again be able to experience every match live and free on SBS."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Celebrating its centenary year, the 2030 FIFA World Cup will be the most geographically diverse tournament in the competition’s history.

It will be the first in history to be played across six host nations — with the opening three matches taking place in Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay before the tournament moves to primary host countries Morocco, Portugal and Spain.

The deal between SBS and FIFA cements a 40-year relationship that dates back to 1986.

"We are delighted to continue our long-standing partnership with SBS," FIFA director of media and partnerships and FIFA+ Jean-Christophe Petit said.

"SBS’s innovative programming, in-depth coverage, nationwide exposure and commitment to showcasing the rich cultural celebration of FIFA World Cup 2026 set new benchmarks for the tournament in Australia this year."

Petit said the new agreement will bring "Australian fans an exceptional viewing experience" of the "landmark edition of the tournament".

Palfreyman said the "important partnership" reflects a "long-standing commitment to making the world’s biggest sporting moments accessible to all Australians".

The agreement follows a massively successful 2026 World Cup for SBS, with the tournament watched by more than 18 million viewers.

Delivering full matches and recaps in 30-minute, 12-minute and three-minute clips on SBS On Demand, SBS reached 209 million hours of consumption — with around 55 per cent being solely digital.

"SBS has always approached the FIFA World Cup as much more than a sporting event," said SBS director of sport Ken Shipp.

"Our job is to capture the football, the stories, the cultures and the emotion that make it unlike anything else in world sport. We’re incredibly proud to have the opportunity to do that again in 2030."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: SBS 巩固了其作为澳大利亚足球精神家园的地位，获得了 2030 年 FIFA 世界杯的独家国家转播权。 热爱足球的澳大利亚人将可以通过 SBS 电视、视频和广播节目观看 2030 年锦标赛的全部 104 场比赛。 SBS 董事总经理简·帕尔弗里曼 (Jane Palfreyman) 表示，该广播公司“毫无疑问”是澳大利亚世界杯的主场。 “国际足联世界杯是为数不多的真正将不同文化、语言和社区的澳大利亚人聚集在一起的体育赛事之一，”她说。 “到 2030 年，观众将再次能够在 SBS 上免费直播每场比赛。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 为庆祝其一百周年，2030 年 FIFA 世界杯将成为赛事历史上地域最多元化的赛事。 这将是历史上首次在六个主办国举行的比赛——前三场比赛将在阿根廷、巴拉圭和乌拉圭举行，然后比赛将移至主要主办国摩洛哥、葡萄牙和西班牙。 SBS 和 FIFA 之间的协议巩固了自 1986 年以来长达 40 年的合作关系。 “我们很高兴继续与 SBS 建立长期合作伙伴关系，”国际足联媒体和合作伙伴兼 FIFA+ 总监让-克里斯托夫·佩蒂特 (Jean-Christophe Petit) 表示。 “SBS 的创新节目、深入报道、全国曝光度以及对展示 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯丰富文化庆祝活动的承诺，为今年在澳大利亚举办的赛事树立了新的基准。” 佩蒂特表示，新协议将为“具有里程碑意义的赛事”带来“澳大利亚球迷非凡的观看体验”。 帕尔弗里曼表示，这一“重要的合作伙伴关系”反映了“让所有澳大利亚人都能参与世界上最盛大的体育赛事的长期承诺”。 该协议是在 SBS 举办的 2026 年世界杯取得巨大成功之后签署的，该赛事有超过 1800 万观众观看。 SBS 在 SBS On Demand 上提供 30 分钟、12 分钟和 3 分钟的完整比赛和回顾片段，观看时长达到 2.09 亿小时，其中约 55% 是完全数字化的。 “SBS 始终将 FIFA 世界杯视为一场体育赛事，”SBS 体育总监肯·希普 (Ken Shipp) 说道。 “我们的工作是捕捉足球、故事、文化和情感，使其与世界体育运动中的其他任何项目不同。我们非常自豪有机会在 2030 年再次做到这一点。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The FIFA World Cup, as described, has a unique power to bridge divides and bring people together. It's a powerful reminder of the biblical vision where people from every nation, tribe, people, and language will stand together in unity. This global event, even in the realm of sport, offers a glimpse of that future hope.
reflection.zh: 正如报道所述，国际足联世界杯具有弥合分歧、团结人心的独特力量。它有力地提醒我们圣经中的异象：万国万族、各民各方的人都将一同站立，合而为一。这项全球性的体育赛事，哪怕只是在体育领域，也让我们得以一窥那未来的盼望。

verse.textEn: A great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne.
verse.textZh: 许多的人，没有人能数过来，是从各国、各族、各民、各方来的，站在宝座……前。

title.en: AusPost boss reveals future of letter deliveries a‌mid stamp price warning
title.zh: 澳大利亚邮政发出投递警告，首席执行官称‘这是我们一生中最艰难的战斗’

summary.en: Australia Post delivered over 1.4 billion letters in the last financial year, a decrease of nearly 15% from the previous year. The company's CEO stated that mail volumes are at levels not seen since the 1930s and warned that the cost of sending a letter could rise to $2, as they face significant challenges due to...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚邮政在上一个财年递送了超过14亿封信件，比前一年下降了近15%。该公司首席执行官表示，邮件量已降至自20世纪30年代以来的最低水平，并警告说，由于邮件使用量下降，寄送一封信的成本可能高达2澳元，他们正面临严峻挑战。

body.en:
Australia Post has warned the cost of sending a letter could eventually rise to $2, as the postal service grapples with a continuing collapse in mail volumes.

Chief executive Paul Graham told SBS News that Australia Post will need to make further changes to the way letters are delivered as fewer Australians use the service, but has ruled out any plans to follow overseas postal services that have moved away from traditional home delivery.

"We continue to see letter decline, 15 per cent last year and we're now seeing letter volumes that we haven't seen since the 1930s," Graham said.

The company has already reduced letter deliveries to every second day and increased the price of a standard stamp, but Graham said further price increases and efficiencies would be needed as letter volumes continued to fall, including potentially reducing delivery frequency even further.

Graham said the company is "in the fight of our lives" , as it navigates structural change and fierce parcel competition squeezes margins.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Graham said Australia Post's current $1.85 lowest-cost stamp remained among the cheapest in comparable economies.

He said that the price of a stamp could eventually rise, but argued the increase would have a relatively small impact on individual households.

He estimated a further increase to $2 would add less than a dollar a year to the cost for a typical household.

The changes are being driven by the widening gap between the cost of maintaining a nationwide letter service and the number of letters being sent.

Australia Post delivered 1.42 billion letters last financial year, almost 15 per cent fewer than the previous year.

At the same time, its parcels and services business continued to grow, generating a record $8.01 billion in revenue.

Despite the pressure on its traditional letter business, Graham said there were no plans for Australia Post to follow postal services overseas by abandoning home delivery or shifting customers towards community mailboxes.

He pointed to the different nature of Australian cities, suburbs and regional communities as a reason.

"The nature of our suburbs and regional towns does not lend itself to that solution," he said.

Instead, Graham said Australia Post wanted to tailor its services to the needs of different communities.

He said the organisation remained "absolutely committed" to ensuring efforts to reduce costs did not come at the expense of people living in regional and remote Australia.

Australia Post currently operates more than 4,000 retail outlets across the country, with about 2,500 in regional and remote areas.

body.zh: 澳大利亚邮政警告称，由于邮政服务面临邮件量持续下降的问题，寄信成本最终可能升至 2 美元。 首席执行官保罗·格雷厄姆 (Paul Graham) 告诉 SBS 新闻，随着使用该服务的澳大利亚人越来越少，澳大利亚邮政将需要进一步改变信件投递方式，但他排除了任何效仿海外邮政服务的计划，这些服务已不再采用传统的送货上门服务。 格雷厄姆说：“我们继续看到信件数量下降，去年下降了 15%，现在我们看到的信件数量是 20 世纪 30 年代以来从未见过的。” 该公司已经将信件投递减少到每两天一次，并提高了标准邮票的价格，但格雷厄姆表示，随着信件数量持续下降，需要进一步提高价格和提高效率，包括可能进一步降低投递频率。 格雷厄姆表示，该公司“正在为我们的生命而战”，因为它正在经历结构性变革，而激烈的包裹竞争挤压了利润。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 格雷厄姆表示，澳大利亚邮政目前1.85澳元的最低成本邮票仍然是同类经济体中最便宜的邮票之一。 他表示，邮票的价格最终可能会上涨，但认为上涨对个人家庭的影响相对较小。 他估计，如果进一步增加到 2 美元，一般家庭每年的开支将增加不到 1 美元。 这些变化是由于维持全国范围的信件服务的成本与发送的信件数量之间的差距不断扩大而推动的。 澳大利亚邮政上一财年投递了 14.2 亿封信件，比上一年减少了近 15%。 与此同时，其包裹和服务业务持续增长，创造了创纪录的80.1亿美元收入。 尽管传统信件业务面临压力，格雷厄姆表示，澳大利亚邮政并没有计划效仿海外邮政服务，放弃送货上门或将客户转向社区邮箱。 他指出澳大利亚城市、郊区和地区社区的不同性质是一个原因。 “我们郊区和地区城镇的性质不适合这种解决方案，”他说。 相反，格雷厄姆表示，澳大利亚邮政希望根据不同社区的需求调整其服务。 他表示，该组织仍然“绝对致力于”确保降低成本的努力不会以牺牲生活在澳大利亚偏远地区的人们的利益为代价。 澳大利亚邮政目前在全国经营着 4,000 多家零售店，其中约 2,500 家位于偏远地区。 格雷厄姆承认澳大利亚邮政存在风险……

This immense challenge calls for dedication and diligence in their work, remembering that all labor, even in the face of decline, can be offered as service to a higher purpose....

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: More popular than Barnaby Joyce? This Australian has won over One Nation voters
title.zh: 比巴纳比·乔伊斯更受欢迎？这位澳大利亚人赢得了‘一国党’选民的青睐

summary.en: One Nation has embraced a controversial figure, and the political payoff is showing. Former SAS corporal Ben Roberts-Smith, though not a candidate, enjoys high popularity among One Nation voters, ranking second only to party leader Pauline Hanson in a recent survey. He also polled higher than prominent political...
summary.zh: ‘一国党’（One Nation）接纳了一位备受争议的人物，其政治回报正在显现。前特种空勤团（SAS）中士本·罗伯茨-史密斯（Ben Roberts-Smith）虽然不是该党的候选人，但在‘一国党’选民中享有很高的声望，在最近的一项民意调查中仅次于党领袖宝琳·韩森（Pauline...

body.en:
He's not a candidate for One Nation, but party voters are rallying behind former SAS corporal Ben Roberts-Smith.

In a recent survey of more than 1,000 One Nation voters, Roberts-Smith returned a 69 per cent popularity rate — second only to party leader Pauline Hanson at 95 per cent.

Utting Research commissioned the study, which saw Roberts-Smith rank higher than Barnaby Joyce at 62 per cent favourability, US President Donald Trump at 42 per cent and Liberal leader Angus Taylor at 32 per cent.

Of those in support of Roberts-Smith, 80 per cent were aged 65 and above, and 77 per cent were ex-Liberal voters.

Utting Research managing director John Utting said there were three reasons why Roberts-Smith ranks so highly.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The first is that he has heroic status — he has received a Victoria Cross and has really been lauded throughout Australian society," Utting explained.

He believes Roberts-Smith is "pretty close" to being a "secular saint" to his supporters.

"Second, here’s an individual that seems to be part of a system that now is turning on him ... and he's very much a culture war proxy," Utting said.

"Media organisations are always interested in him and essentially, from these people's point of view, are attacking him and seen to have their own agendas."

Utting said Roberts-Smith's popularity may not have much to do with the man himself.

"He's a symbol for a whole lot of issues in the country ... most people only have the vaguest, if at all, understanding of his present sort of legal predicament," he said.

"A lot of people are operating off a very low information base and don't understand what’s happening to him.

Roberts-Smith was arrested in April, charged with war crimes for the alleged murders of unarmed civilians while serving in Afghanistan between 2009 and 2012. He is currently on bail, awaiting trial.

After his arrest, anti-immigration organisation the National Workers Alliance organised a rally outside Victoria's Parliament House, calling for charges to be dropped.

National Workers Alliance leader Matt Trihey, a self-described nationalist, told the crowd the veteran's arrest was "an absolute injustice".

A spokesperson for Roberts-Smith and his family told AAP they weren't involved or associated with the organisers and had not "been consulted by the group in question".

During the Farrer by-election, One Nation used a photograph of Roberts-Smith on campaign signs .

Dr Jordan McSwiney, senior research fellow at the University of Canberra's Centre of Deliberative Democracy, said One Nation’s "adoption" of Roberts-Smith wasn’t surprising.

reflection.en: This news highlights how political figures can gain significant public favor, even when associated with controversy. It prompts reflection on what qualities voters truly value and seek in leadership. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness is found not in popularity, but in acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了政治人物如何能获得显著的公众青睐，即使他们与争议有关。这促使我们反思选民真正看重和寻求的领导品质是什么。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义不在于受欢迎程度，而在于秉行公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: A new proposal to limit our scrolling has a precedent. But would it work?
title.zh: 一项限制我们滚动的新提案有先例。但它会奏效吗？

summary.en: Australia is considering copying Europe's playbook on limiting addictive social media feeds, but the results are mixed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚正在考虑效仿欧洲限制成瘾性社交媒体推送内容的做法，但效果好坏参半。

body.en:
For years, social media companies have relied on powerful algorithms to decide what Australians see in their feeds, using their personal data and behaviour to keep them scrolling.

The federal government is drafting "digital duty of care" legislation that would require social media companies to identify risks and take steps to reduce online harm.

Among the proposals is a push to "Fix Our Feeds", which would give Australians greater control over whether algorithms personalise the content they see.

But Australia would not be the first jurisdiction to try to rein in the algorithms that determine what users see.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The European Union has already introduced rules requiring the largest social media platforms to give users an alternative to personalised recommendations.

The experience offers a warning for Australia: giving people more control over their feeds does not necessarily mean they will use it.

The EU's Digital Services Act, which began applying to the largest online platforms in 2023, was designed to strengthen users' rights and give them greater control over their online experiences.

"Europe is now effectively the first jurisdiction in the world where online platforms no longer benefit from a 'free pass' and set their own rules," then EU commissioner Thierry Breton said in 2023.

Under the rules, the largest platforms — those with more than 45 million monthly users in the EU — must offer at least one recommendation option that is not based on users' personal profiling.

Instagram and Facebook users now have feeds that show content in the order it was posted and more closely resemble how social media worked before personalised feeds became central to the platforms.

Proponents argue chronological feeds may be less addictive because users can feel they have "caught up", rather than being drawn into endless scrolling.

But Patrik Wikström, a professor of computational communication at Queensland University of Technology, said the European regulations had shortcomings.

"Even if we say 'We don't want the platforms to know an awful lot about us, we don't want this to be personalised, and we don't want these rabbit holes and echo chambers', at the end of the day, when we're sitting there and scrolling, we like it," he told SBS News.

"People still stick to the personalised platform because it is there for a reason. It's tuned perfectly to our brains and to make us stay as long as possible on the platform, and it's hard to escape."

reflection.en: Social media platforms often employ sophisticated algorithms designed to capture and hold our attention, sometimes to our detriment. This news prompts reflection on our own consumption habits and the need to intentionally direct our minds toward what is beneficial and true, rather than being passively swept along by endless scrolling. As we navigate the...
reflection.zh: 社交媒体平台常常采用复杂的算法来吸引并留住我们的注意力，有时甚至对我们造成损害。这则新闻促使我们反思自身的媒介消费习惯，以及有意识地将心思引导至有益和真实事物上的必要性，而不是被无休止的滚动所裹挟。当我们穿梭于数字世界时，培养一颗专注的心，正如腓立比书4:8所鼓励的那样，对于身心健康至关重要。
