title.zh: 蒂亚戈·卡拉伊和劳迪西亚·贝尼特斯帮助收复瓜拉尼土地。他们上个月与孩子们一起在一场事故中丧生。

summary.en: On August 14th, seven people from Tekoa Kalipety were traveling between Guarani communities with seeds. They had spent the week checking in on relatives, praying at Porto Lindo, and sharing traditional seeds harvested back home in southern São Paulo. They were on their way to another Indigenous territory when, on that...
summary.zh: 8月14日，来自Tekoa Kalipety的七个人带着种子在瓜拉尼社区之间旅行。他们本周一直在探望亲戚，在Porto Lindo祈祷，并分享从南部圣保罗家乡收获的传统种子。他们正前往另一个原住民领地，那天晚上，一辆载有玉米的半挂车从卡车上脱落，撞上了他们的汽车。蒂亚戈·洪诺里奥·多斯·桑托斯（Tiago...

body.en: On August 14th, seven people from Tekoa Kalipety were traveling between Guarani communities with seeds. They had spent the week checking in on relatives, praying at Porto Lindo, and sharing traditional seeds harvested back home in southern São Paulo. They were on their way to another Indigenous territory when, on that evening, a semitrailer carrying maize detached from a truck and struck their car. Tiago Honório dos Santos, known as Tiago Karaí, 34, died with his wife, Kerexu Laudiceia Benites, 31; their children, Tadeu, 14, and Luna, seven; Tiago’s sister, Kerexu Cleonice Honório dos Santos; and two other members of Kalipety, Ileo Benites and Genilson Euzébio Karay Mirim. The truck driver fled the scene. Tiago Karaí. Courtesy of Synchronicity Earth Kerexu Laudiceia smoking a petyngua, the Guarani people’s sacred pipe. Image by Fellipe Abreu. Tiago was born in a Guarani village near the coast of São Paulo state. His parents moved to the Tenondé Porã Indigenous Territory before he was two. At the Guarani Gwyra Pepó school, he wondered why children were taught so little about Guarani life. After finishing secondary school at 19, he returned to the school as a teacher. Known then as Karaí Tataendy, he taught Guarani language and culture to primary-school children. He believed they needed to know both Guarani and non-Indigenous ways of life. Teaching their own language gave them something he had found missing when he sat in the same classrooms. In 2013, Guarani families began reclaiming ancestral sections of Tenondé Porã, moving onto…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 8 月 14 日，来自 Tekoa Kalipety 的 7 个人带着种子在瓜拉尼社区之间穿梭。他们花了一周时间探望亲戚，在林多港祈祷，并分享在圣保罗南部家乡收获的传统种子。那天晚上，他们正在前往另一个原住民领地的路上，一辆运载玉米的半挂车从卡车上脱落，撞上了他们的车。蒂亚戈·霍诺里奥·多斯桑托斯（Tiago Honório dos Santos），又名蒂亚戈·卡拉伊（Tiago Karaí），34 岁，与 31 岁的妻子凯雷克斯·劳迪西娅·贝尼特斯（Kerexu Laudiceia Benites）一起去世；他们的孩子是 14 岁的塔德乌 (Tadeu) 和七岁的卢娜 (Luna)；蒂亚戈的妹妹 Kerexu Cleonice Honório dos Santos；以及 Kalipety 的另外两名成员，Ileo Benites 和 Genilson Euzébio Karay Mirim。卡车司机逃离了现场。蒂亚戈·卡拉伊。由 Synchronicity Earth Kerexu Laudiceia 提供，抽着瓜拉尼人神圣的烟斗 petyngua。图片由费利佩·阿布鲁拍摄。蒂亚戈出生在圣保罗州海岸附近的一个瓜拉尼村庄。在他两岁之前，他的父母就搬到了 Tenondé Porã 原住民领地。在瓜拉尼 Gwyra Pepó 学校，他想知道为什么孩子们对瓜拉尼生活的了解如此之少。 19岁中学毕业后，他回到学校担任教师。他当时被称为卡拉伊·塔坦迪 (Karaí Tataendy)，向小学生教授瓜拉尼语和文化。他认为他们需要了解瓜拉尼人和非原住民的生活方式。教他们自己的语言给了他们一些他在同一间教室里时发现缺失的东西。 2013 年，瓜拉尼家庭开始收回 Tenondé Porã 的祖传地段，并转向……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: Tiago Karaí and Laudiceia Benites were dedicated to their community, traveling with seeds to share and sustain their people. Their lives, and the lives of their children, were tragically cut short in a sudden accident. This loss is a stark reminder of the fragility of life and the deep sorrow that can descend upon families and communities, especially those...
reflection.zh: 蒂亚戈·卡拉伊和劳迪西亚·贝尼特斯致力于他们的社区，带着种子旅行，分享并支持他们的人民。他们的生命，以及他们孩子的生命，在一次突如其来的事故中不幸被缩短。这一损失是生命脆弱性的一个严峻提醒，也是可以降临在家庭和社区身上的深切悲痛，尤其是那些努力保护自己遗产并相互支持的社区。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Biomass cooking fuels raise toxic metal exposure risks in Bangladesh, study finds
title.zh: 孟加拉国研究发现：生物质烹饪燃料增加有毒金属暴露风险

summary.en: A new study indicates that burning biomass fuels such as dry wood and rice husks for cooking in rural Bangladesh can lead to indoor air pollution and the accumulation of toxic heavy metals within kitchens. The research highlights a gap in understanding indoor pollution in these communities, with potential sources of...
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，在孟加拉国农村地区，燃烧干木材和稻壳等生物质燃料做饭会产生室内空气污染，并导致厨房内积聚有毒重金属。该研究强调了对这些社区室内污染认识的不足，重金属的潜在来源包括农田中使用的肥料。

body.en: Burning biomass fuels like dry wood and rice husk for cooking can produce air pollution and contribute to toxic heavy metals buildup inside rural kitchens in Bangladesh, a new study finds. Md. Badiuzzaman Khan, an environmental science professor at Bangladesh Agricultural University and the study’s lead author, said the research addresses a gap in understanding indoor pollution in rural communities. “Local people use various kinds of fuels like cowdung, or branches of wood or agricultural byproducts like rice straw or jute sticks,” Khan said in an email to Mongabay. “Heavy metals may come to rice straw or jute sticks from the fertilizers used in the crop field. Heavy metals may also come from natural sources like soil.” For this study, researchers collected dust samples from the walls and ceilings of 63 households in Bangladesh’s Haor and Charland regions, which both heavily rely on biomass fuel. They also analyzed 11 composite samples of biomass fuels used for cooking and examined their elemental composition. The study ran from November 2022 to March 2023. Many low-income rural households use biomass, potentially exposing people to heavy metals and the health consequences associated with them. However, most pollution research in Bangladesh has largely focused on cities; little is known about rural exposure. The study found that the heavy metals in household dust likely come from both human activities, such as farming and burning fuel, and natural sources such as soil and sediments carried by floods. The types of metals found also differed between the two…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 一项新的研究发现，燃烧干木和稻壳等生物质燃料进行烹饪会产生空气污染，并导致孟加拉国农村厨房内有毒重金属的积累。该研究的主要作者、孟加拉国农业大学环境科学教授巴迪乌扎曼·汗 (Badiuzzaman Khan) 表示，该研究填补了对农村社区室内污染的理解空白。 “当地人使用各种燃料，如牛粪、树枝或农副产品，如稻草或黄麻棒，”汗在给 Mongabay 的电子邮件中说。 “重金属可能来自农田使用的肥料中的稻草或黄麻棒。重金属也可能来自土壤等自然资源。”在这项研究中，研究人员从孟加拉国 Haor 和 Charland 地区 63 个家庭的墙壁和天花板上收集了灰尘样本，这些家庭都严重依赖生物质燃料。他们还分析了 11 个用于烹饪的生物质燃料的复合样品，并检查了它们的元素成分。该研究从 2022 年 11 月持续到 2023 年 3 月。许多低收入农村家庭使用生物质，可能使人们接触重金属并产生与之相关的健康后果。然而，孟加拉国的大多数污染研究主要集中在城市；人们对农村地区的暴露知之甚少。研究发现，家庭灰尘中的重金属可能来自农业和燃烧燃料等人类活动，以及洪水携带的土壤和沉积物等自然资源。两者之间发现的金属类型也有所不同……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The study from Bangladesh reveals how everyday practices, like cooking with biomass, can inadvertently harm both people and their environment. Genesis 2:15 calls us to tend and care for creation. This reminds us that our stewardship extends to the air within our homes and the materials we use, urging us to seek healthier, more sustainable ways of living...
reflection.zh: 来自孟加拉国的研究揭示了日常的烹饪习俗如何会无意中伤害人类及其环境。创世记2:15呼吁我们照料和管理受造物。这提醒我们，我们的管理责任延伸到我们家中的空气以及我们使用的材料，敦促我们寻求更健康、更可持续的生活方式，以荣耀雅伟的创造。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: In Indonesia, 20 Indigenous subtribes seek common ground amid mining divisions
title.zh: 在印尼，20个原住民亚部落在采矿分歧中寻求共同点

summary.en: For generations, Raja Ampat’s Indigenous communities have governed different territories according to their customary systems, each with distinct identities and claims. Recently, nickel mining has created new divisions, with some communities viewing it as an economic opportunity while others fear environmental damage....
summary.zh: 世世代代以来，拉贾安帕特的原住民社区根据其习俗体系管理着不同的领土，每个社区都有独特的身份和主张。最近，镍矿开采造成了新的分歧，一些社区将其视为经济机会，而另一些社区则担心环境遭到破坏。为了解决这个问题，来自20个原住民亚部落的代表于2026年8月20日至23日在阿尔博雷克岛集会，以寻求共同点，并就他们的未来统一他们的...

body.en: ARBOREK, Southwest Papua, Indonesia — For generations, Raja Ampat’s Indigenous communities have governed different forests, reefs and islands according to their customary systems. Those communities have distinct identities and territorial claims, which sometimes overlap or lead to disputes. Recently, nickel mining has created new divisions, with some communities seeing the industry as an economic opportunity, while others fear it will damage the land and sea on which they depend. Against that backdrop, representatives of 20 Indigenous subtribes gathered in the tiny island village of Arborek from Aug. 20-23, 2026, to find common ground and strengthen their collective voice over the future of Raja Ampat. The gathering, called Heyul Pelei Koranu Fyak, takes its name from the two major Indigenous groups in Raja Ampat, the Maya and Biak. Heyul Pelei is a Maya term meaning grand gathering, while Koranu Fyak in Biak means Indigenous people. The gathering, , was the culmination of a consolidation effort among Indigenous communities in Raja Ampat that began in 2025. It was organized by the Forum Gelar Senat Masyarakat Adat Raja Ampat in collaboration with Institut USBA, an Indigenous-focused organization based in Southwest Papua, and Greenpeace Indonesia. As night fell on the first day, representatives from each participating subtribe introduced themselves and shared stories from their respective villages. Many spoke about struggles over land, resources and environmental protection. The gathering ultimately produced a common resolution opposing mining in Raja Ampat. The Indigenous community of Arborek village welcomed the participants of the Heyul Pelei Koranu Fyak gathering,…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度尼西亚巴布亚西南部阿博雷克——几代人以来，拉贾安帕的原住民社区都根据自己的习惯制度管理着不同的森林、珊瑚礁和岛屿。这些社区具有不同的身份和领土主张，有时会重叠或导致争端。最近，镍矿开采产生了新的分歧，一些社区将该行业视为一个经济机会，而另一些社区则担心这会损害他们赖以生存的土地和海洋。在此背景下，20 个土著部落的代表于 2026 年 8 月 20 日至 23 日齐聚 Arborek 小岛村庄，寻找共同点并加强他们对四王群岛未来的集体声音。这次聚会名为 Heyul Pelei Koranu Fyak，得名于拉贾安帕的两个主要原住民群体：玛雅人和比亚克人。 Heyul Pelei 是玛雅语，意思是盛大的聚会，而 Koranu Fyak 在 Biak 中的意思是原住民。这次聚会是四王群岛原住民社区自 2025 年开始的整合努力的顶峰。这次聚会是由四王群岛论坛 Gelar Senat Masyarakat Adat Raja Ampat 与巴布亚西南部专注于原住民的组织 Institut USBA 和印度尼西亚绿色和平组织合作组织的。第一天夜幕降临，各参赛社区代表分别进行了自我介绍，并分享了各自村庄的故事。许多人谈到了土地、资源和环境保护方面的斗争。会议最终达成了反对在拉贾安帕采矿的共同决议。 Arborek 村的原住民社区欢迎 Heyul Pelei Koranu Fyak 聚会的参与者，……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: In the face of potential division over resource development, representatives from 20 Indigenous subtribes in Raja Ampat convened to seek common ground. This gathering embodies the wisdom of seeking understanding, as Proverbs 18:15 states, "The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out." Their effort to strengthen a...
reflection.zh: 面对资源开发可能带来的分歧，拉贾安帕特20个原住民亚部落的代表齐聚一堂，寻求共同点。这次集会体现了寻求理解的智慧，正如箴言18:15所说：“明达人的心必得知识，智慧人的耳寻求知识。”他们努力加强集体声音，证明了在应对复杂挑战时，共同商议和相互理解的价值。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Judge strikes down New York law that forced climate polluters to pay damages
title.zh: 法官驳回纽约州法律，该法律强制气候污染者支付损害赔偿

summary.en: A federal judge has struck down a New York law that would have required major oil companies to pay $75 billion over 25 years for climate mitigation and adaptation. The ruling sided with oil interests, stating the state cannot enforce the "climate superfund" law.
summary.zh: 一位联邦法官驳回了纽约州一项强制大型石油公司在25年内支付750亿美元用于气候缓解和适应的法律。该裁决支持了石油公司的利益，认为该州无法执行这项“气候超级基金”法。

body.en: State cannot enforce policy requiring oil firms to pay $75bn over 25 years for climate mitigation and adaptation A federal judge has struck down a landmark New York law that forces major polluters to pay climate damages. In her Monday ruling, Brenda Sannes, chief judge of the US district court for the northern district of New York, sided with Republican-led states and oil interests in saying the state cannot enforce its “climate superfund” law, signed by Kathy Hochul, the governor, in December 2024. The policy required big oil companies to pay $75bn over 25 years for projects to help New York pay for climate mitigation and adaptation. Continue reading...
body.zh: 州政府无法执行要求石油公司在 25 年内支付 750 亿美元用于减缓和适应气候变化的政策。一位联邦法官否决了纽约州一项具有里程碑意义的法律，该法律迫使主要污染者支付气候损害赔偿金。美国纽约北区地方法院首席法官布伦达·桑内斯 (Brenda Sannes) 在周一的裁决中站在了共和党领导的各州和石油利益集团的一边，称该州无法执行州长凯西·霍赫尔 (Kathy Hochul) 于 2024 年 12 月签署的“气候超级基金”法。该政策要求大型石油公司在 25 年内支付 750 亿美元用于帮助纽约支付气候减缓和适应费用的项目。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story of New York's "climate superfund" law being struck down raises profound questions about accountability for environmental damage. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with our God.' This verse challenges us to consider how we balance economic interests with our responsibility to care for creation and ensure justice...
reflection.zh: 纽约州“气候超级基金”法被驳回的故事，引发了关于环境损害责任的深刻问题。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行”。这节经文促使我们思考，如何在经济利益与我们照顾受造界以及确保受其退化影响者的正义之间取得平衡。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

This human ingenuity, seeking to understand and coexist with the ocean's inhabitants, echoes the Psalmist's awe at the vastness and intricate design of the natural world. The wisdom displayed in creation, from the smallest creature to...
reflection.zh: 为应对鲨鱼袭击的威胁，新南威尔士州正在部署先进的无人机技术来监测其海滩。这种人类的创造力，试图理解并与海洋生物共存，呼应了诗篇作者对自然界浩瀚和精妙设计的敬畏之情。从最小的生物到最壮阔的海洋，创造中所展现的智慧，邀请我们进行深思熟虑的管理和探索。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Suburban Sprawl Puts Western Homes at Risk from Wildfires
title.zh: 郊区扩张使西部房屋面临野火风险

summary.en: Recent fires in Spokane, Washington, and Reno, Nevada, highlight the dangers of suburban expansion into wildland areas, where homes built on the urban fringe are increasingly at risk from encroaching wildfires.
summary.zh: 近期在华盛顿州斯波坎和内华达州里诺发生的火灾，凸显了郊区扩张到荒野地区的危险，位于城市边缘的房屋正日益面临野火侵袭的风险。

body.en:
This article was originally published by Grist and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration.

Recent fires in Spokane, Washington, and Reno, Nevada, illustrate the risks from suburban sprawl, experts say. In both cities, encroaching flames burned homes built at the edge of wilderness.

Somersett, a short drive from downtown Reno, Nevada, is a peaceful place where homes with sweeping, high-desert views line cul-de-sacs and roads meander through shrubland, trailheads, and golf courses. But in the summer, months of low humidity and hot weather prime the landscape to burn. On the morning of August 22, it did.

In just a few days, strong winds carried the flames of the Hawk Fire more than 23 miles, placing some 90,000 people on evacuation notice as dense smoke and orange skies blanketed the city. By Wednesday, dozens of houses had been destroyed. Two weeks earlier, the Bug Fire burned 150 square miles just north of the same area.

It’s the latest in an era of worsening wildfires in the United States, where more than 7.9 million acres have burned this year. A similar story is playing out in Canada, where First Nations and residents of Ontario have borne the brunt of more than 5,100 fires across the country. Scientists say climate change has made these fires, along with others in Europe, significantly more likely to happen. This year’s blazes in the western U.S. were exacerbated by record-low winter snowfall, depriving the landscape of the moisture that typically seeps from snowpack throughout the summer, and by extreme and long-lasting heat waves that baked the landscape.

And the fires have highlighted another, deadly piece of the puzzle: suburban sprawl.

“What’s happened over the last decades is we’ve had explosive population growth in naturally fire-prone areas,” said Tim Brown, director of the Western Regional Climate Center at the Desert Research Institute in Nevada. “People are moving in to where fire happens.”

The wildland-urban interface, which researchers often call the WUI, is the phrase given to places where housing is sandwiched between paved city centers and forests or grasslands. Researchers have been raising the alarm about the fire risk posed to homes in these areas since the 1980s. As humans burn more fossil fuels and warm the planet, longer and more severe droughts will likely make that risk worse. Reno is the fastest warming city in the U.S., according to the nonprofit Climate Central.

These half-wild, half-suburban neighborhoods remain one of the most rapidly growing types of land in the country, although development has slowed compared to the surge between the 1990s and 2010s. In some places, housing scarcity in cities has pushed home buyers to the outskirts of towns, where building is generally cheaper and...
body.zh: 本文最初由 Grist 发表，并作为气候台合作的一部分转载于此。 专家表示，华盛顿州斯波坎和内华达州里诺最近发生的火灾凸显了郊区扩张的风险。在这两个城市，蔓延的火焰烧毁了建在荒野边缘的房屋。 萨默塞特距离内华达州里诺市中心仅很短的车程，是一个宁静的地方，这里的房屋坐落在死胡同中，可欣赏一览无余的高沙漠景色，道路蜿蜒穿过灌木丛、步道入口和高尔夫球场。但在夏季，几个月的低湿度和炎热的天气很容易导致土地燃烧。 8月22日上午，事情果然发生了。 短短几天内，强风将霍克大火的火焰吹了超过 23 英里，浓烟和橙色天空笼罩了整个城市，导致约 9 万人接到疏散通知。到周三，已有数十栋房屋被毁。两周前，虫火在同一地区北部燃烧了 150 平方英里。 这是美国山火不断恶化的最新情况，今年美国的火灾面积已超过 790 万英亩。类似的故事也在加拿大上演，原住民和安大略省的居民在全国范围内发生了 5,100 多起火灾中首当其冲。科学家表示，气候变化使得这些火灾以及欧洲的其他火灾发生的可能性大大增加。今年美国西部的大火因冬季降雪量创历史新低而加剧，导致整个夏季的积雪失去了通常从积雪中渗出的水分，而且极端而持久的热浪烘烤了大地。 火灾凸显了另一个致命的难题：郊区扩张。 内华达州沙漠研究所西部区域气候中心主任蒂姆·布朗说：“过去几十年来，自然火灾多发地区的人口出现爆炸性增长。” “人们正在搬到发生火灾的地方。” 研究人员通常将荒地与城市界面称为“WUI”，这个短语指的是住房夹在铺好的城市中心和森林或草地之间的地方。自 20 世纪 80 年代以来，研究人员一直对这些地区的房屋火灾风险发出警报。随着人类燃烧更多的化石燃料并使地球变暖，更长时间、更严重的干旱可能会使这种风险变得更加严重。据非营利组织气候中心称，里诺是美国变暖最快的城市。 这些半野生、半郊区的社区仍然是该国增长最快的土地类型之一，尽管与 20 世纪 90 年代至 2010 年代的激增相比，开发速度有所放缓。在一些地方，城市住房稀缺迫使购房者前往城镇郊区，那里的建筑通常更便宜，而且......

reflection.en: The expansion of human settlements into natural landscapes, as seen in Spokane and Reno, brings with it inherent risks. The earth itself seems to groan under the pressure of development, with wildlands becoming tinderboxes and homes caught in the crossfire. This situation calls us to consider our stewardship of creation and the unintended consequences of...
reflection.zh: 人类聚居地向自然景观的扩张，如在斯波坎和里诺所见，带来了固有的风险。大地本身似乎在发展的压力下呻吟，野地变成了火药桶，房屋则卷入了战火。这种情况促使我们反思我们对受造界的管理以及我们选择所带来的意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

As technology improves, scientists are decoding the intricate patterns that make different species’ vocalisations distinctive. Madeleine Finlay hears from Emma Bryce, a journalist who has spent months investigating human efforts to understand whale song. This pursuit of knowledge about creation mirrors the ancient truth that the heavens and earth declare the glory and wisdom of Yahweh, inviting us to observe and learn.

title.zh: 超级自然评论——众包的Super 8电影是对自然世界充满希望的胜利拼贴

summary.en: Filmmaker Ed Sayers’ project gathered footage from collaborators all over the world, cleverly edited to combine human and animal contributions. This delightful, fleet-footed film represents a labour of love both for its writer-director-producer-editor, Briton Ed Sayers, and his many, many collaborators who shot the...
summary.zh: 电影制作人埃德·赛尔斯（Ed Sayers）的项目汇集了来自世界各地的合作者的镜头，巧妙地将人类和动物的贡献结合在一起。这部令人愉快的、轻快的电影是其编剧、导演、制片人和剪辑师、英国人埃德·赛尔斯以及他众多全球拍摄Super 8电影素材的合作者们的心血结晶。

body.en: Film-maker Ed Sayers’ project gathered footage from collaborators all over the world, cleverly edited to combine human and animal contributions This delightful, fleet-footed film represents a labour of love both for its writer-director-producer-editor, Briton Ed Sayers, and his many, many collaborators who shot the film’s footage on Super 8 all over the world. Between them they’ve used decades-old rigs in newfangled setups with stock that, like several of the species seen here, would have gone extinct had it not been for the intervention of enthusiasts. The brief from Sayers was simply to film nature, so we get shots of all manner of flora and fauna, ranging from coral reefs to high deserts, places populated by minute bugs all the way up to whales. Given Super 8 reels can only capture a few minutes’ worth of stock, this must have been a fiendishly complex puzzle in the editing room, so all credit to Sayers not just for his own lovely footage and clever vision but for his nimble collaging of the whole thing together. Continue reading...
body.zh: 电影制作人埃德·塞耶斯 (Ed Sayers) 的项目收集了世界各地合作者的镜头，经过巧妙剪辑，将人类和动物的贡献结合起来。这部令人愉悦、动作敏捷的电影代表了编剧、导演、制片人兼剪辑师英国人埃德·塞耶斯 (Briton Ed Sayers) 以及他在世界各地的 Super 8 上拍摄该影片镜头的众多合作者的爱的劳动。他们在新奇的装置中使用了几十年前的装备，其库存就像这里看到的几个物种一样，如果没有爱好者的干预，这些装备可能已经灭绝。塞耶斯的任务很简单，就是拍摄大自然，所以我们拍摄了各种各样的动植物群，从珊瑚礁到高地沙漠，从微小的虫子到鲸鱼栖息的地方。鉴于 Super 8 卷轴只能捕捉几分钟的素材，这在剪辑室里一定是一个极其复杂的难题，所以这一切都归功于塞耶斯，不仅因为他自己可爱的镜头和聪明的视野，还因为他将整个事情灵活地拼贴在一起。继续阅读...

Even in the smallest details, from coral reefs to deserts, the intricate design and beauty of creation point to something greater than ourselves. It is a testament to human curiosity and collaboration, reflecting...

title.en: As Death Toll From Nepal Flood Rises, Officials Call to Tackle Warming
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水死亡人数上升，官员呼吁应对气候变暖

summary.en: Five days after a devastating flood swept through Rasuwa, Nepal, the death toll continues to rise. Authorities reported on Monday that 903 people have been confirmed dead, with another 4,247 missing, as the country grapples with a disaster experts suggest may be linked to melting glacial ice.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区发生灾难性洪水五天后，死亡人数持续攀升。当局周一报告称，已有903人确认死亡，另有4247人失踪，该国正努力应对一场专家认为可能与冰川融化有关的灾难。

body.en:
Five days after a calamitous flood washed through Rasuwa, Nepal, the death toll continues to climb. Authorities said Monday that 903 people have been confirmed dead, while another 4,247 are missing, as the country reels from a disaster that experts say may be linked to the melting of glacial ice.

Officials believe the collapse of a glacier on Langtang Lirung peak sent an avalanche of ice and rock careening into a valley below, where it blocked the flow of the Trishuli River. When the rock barrier finally gave way, they say, it unleashed a rush of water and mud several stories high. The floodwaters inundated villages along the river, not just in Nepal but also in neighboring Tibet, where 16 people are confirmed dead and another 546 are still missing, according to Chinese state media.

Researchers with the HiRisk project, which tracks threats from melting ice in the Himalayas, say that the shrinking and thawing of glaciers may have fueled the disaster. Over the last three decades, Nepali mountains have lost roughly a third of their ice , the U.N. says. The glacier on Langtang Lirung retreated roughly 1,500 feet between 1990 and 2020, and experts say the loss of ice may have left the slope more vulnerable to a landslide.

Further upping the risk of collapse was a warm spell that melted snow atop Langtang Lirung in the days before the flood. “That snowmelt had to go somewhere – and it may have supplied the water that lubricated the rockfall,” said Umesh Haritashya , a geoscientist at the University of Dayton.

The upper Himalayas are warming nearly twice as fast as the global average, experts say, and August is the warmest time of year in the region. “While scientists are still studying the exact causes of this disaster, it is exactly the type of event that is triggered by climate change,” said Wouter Buytaert , a hydrologist at Imperial College London.

U.N. climate chief Simon Stiell said in a statement that a warming climate “is making tragedies like this one, and so many others around the world, much more likely, frequent, and severe, with vulnerable communities often hardest hit.”

In a press conference on Saturday, Nepal’s foreign minister, Shisir Khanal, called on countries to address warming. “We’d ask the world,” he said, “to take climate change as one of the major challenges that Nepal and its citizens face, and this has to be a global effort.”
body.zh: 尼泊尔拉苏瓦发生灾难性洪水五天后，死亡人数继续攀升。当局周一表示，已确认 903 人死亡，另有 4,247 人失踪，专家称这场灾难可能与冰川融化有关，该国正遭受这场灾难的困扰。 官员们认为，Langtang Lirung峰上的冰川崩塌导致雪崩，冰块和岩石倾泻到下面的山谷中，阻塞了Trishuli河的水流。他们说，当岩石屏障最终崩溃时，它释放出了几层楼高的水和泥浆。据中国官方媒体报道，洪水不仅淹没了尼泊尔，还淹没了邻近的西藏沿河村庄，已确认 16 人死亡，另有 546 人失踪。 HiRisk项目的研究人员追踪喜马拉雅山冰川融化的威胁，他们表示，冰川的缩小和融化可能加剧了这场灾难。联合国称，在过去三十年里，尼泊尔山区大约失去了三分之一的冰。 1990 年至 2020 年间，Langtang Lirung 上的冰川后退了大约 1,500 英尺，专家表示，冰的消失可能使斜坡更容易发生山体滑坡。 洪水发生前几天，Langtang Lirung 山顶的积雪融化，进一步增加了塌陷的风险。代顿大学地球科学家乌梅什·哈里塔什亚 (Umesh Haritashya) 表示：“融雪必须流向某个地方，它可能提供了润滑落石的水。” 专家表示，喜马拉雅山上游的变暖速度几乎是全球平均水平的两倍，而八月是该地区一年中最温暖的时间。伦敦帝国理工学院水文学家 Wouter Buytaert 表示：“虽然科学家仍在研究这场灾难的确切原因，但这正是气候变化引发的事件类型。” 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔在一份声明中表示，气候变暖“正在导致像这样的悲剧以及世界各地许多其他悲剧发生，而且发生的可能性更大、更频繁、更严重，脆弱社区往往受到的打击最严重。” 在周六的新闻发布会上，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔呼吁各国应对气候变暖问题。 “我们要求世界，”他说，“将气候变化视为尼泊尔及其公民面临的主要挑战之一，而这必须是全球的共同努力。”

reflection.en: The earth groans, as the Apostle Paul wrote, and this flood in Nepal is a stark reminder of that reality. The melting glacier that likely triggered this disaster points to the deep interconnectedness of our world and the impact of environmental changes on vulnerable communities. May we heed the calls to address warming and care for the creation entrusted to...
reflection.zh: 正如使徒保罗所写，万物都在一同叹息，而尼泊尔的这场洪水正是这一现实的严峻提醒。可能引发这场灾难的冰川融化，揭示了我们世界深刻的相互联系，以及环境变化对脆弱社区的影响。愿我们听从应对气候变暖的呼吁，并照管那托付给我们的受造之物。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: ‘Led us down such a dark path’: documentary explores how 9/11 changed America
title.zh: “把我们引向如此黑暗的道路”：纪录片探讨 9/11 如何改变了美国

summary.en: The Netflix film 'Turning Point: Generation 9/11' examines the lives of those profoundly affected by the 2001 terrorist attacks. As the US approaches a point where half its population was born after 9/11 or was too young to remember it, the film's director compares the event's distance to the bombing of Hiroshima,...
summary.zh: Netflix 电影《转折点：9/11 一代》探讨了 2001 年恐怖袭击事件的深刻影响。随着美国即将迎来半数人口出生在 9/11 之后或对该事件记忆模糊的时刻，该片导演将此次事件的久远感比作广岛原子弹爆炸，凸显了其持久的影响。

body.en: In Netflix film Turning Point: Generation 9/11, the lives of people forever impacted by the terrorist attack in 2001 are explored Twenty-five years on, memory is giving way to history. Soon the US will cross the point where half its population were born after 11 September 2001 or were too young to remember the day that terrorists crashed planes into the World Trade Center in New York, the Pentagon in northern Virginia and a field in Shanksville, Pennsylvania. “When I do that math, I get to the bomb at Hiroshima – that’s how distant it is,” says Brian Knappenberger, 56, director of a new Netflix documentary, Turning Point: Generation 9/11 . “When we talk about the second world war, for our generation it seemed like a long time ago but, for the current generation of 20-year-olds, that’s how long ago it was.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 Netflix 电影《转折点：9/11 世代》中，探索了 2001 年遭受恐怖袭击永远影响的人们的生活。二十五年过去了，记忆正在让位于历史。很快，美国将有一半人口出生于 2001 年 9 月 11 日之后，或者年龄太小，不记得恐怖分子将飞机撞向纽约世贸中心、弗吉尼亚州北部五角大楼和宾夕法尼亚州尚克斯维尔田野的那一天。 56 岁的布莱恩·纳彭伯格 (Brian Knappenberger) 是 Netflix 一部新纪录片《转折点：第 9/11 代》的导演，他说：“当我计算时，我会想到广岛的原子弹——这就是它的距离。” “当我们谈论第二次世界大战时，对于我们这一代人来说，这似乎是很久以前的事了，但对于现在这一代 20 岁的人来说，那就是很久以前的事了。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary 'Turning Point: Generation 9/11' revisits the profound and lasting impact of the 9/11 attacks, which the director describes as leading America down a 'dark path.' This phrase captures the difficult truth that responding to evil with further conflict can perpetuate suffering and unintended consequences, a cycle that Scripture warns against....
reflection.zh: 纪录片《转折点：9/11 一代》重温了 9/11 袭击事件深远而持久的影响，导演称其将美国引向了一条“黑暗的道路”。这句话恰当地概括了一个严峻的事实：以冲突回应邪恶可能会延续苦难和产生意想不到的后果，这正是圣经所警示的循环。‘以善胜恶’（罗马书 12:21）的呼召，即使面对深重的创伤和损失，也促使我们寻求治愈与和解之路。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries …
title.zh: 穆里尼奥影评——如果他不想敞开心扉，也许他就不该出演纪录片……

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: The Black Garden review – haunting study of growing up in war-torn Nagorno-Karabakh
title.zh: 《黑花园》评论——对在战火纷飞的纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫长大的孩子的凄美研究

summary.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict. After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless...
summary.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米扬的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔和阿沃两个十岁出头的男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地被残酷的冲突所伤害。苏联于1991年解体后，一场持续数十年的领土争端在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发，当地主要是亚美尼亚人口与阿塞拜疆军队进行了无数次军事战役的斗争。这部影片拍摄历时三年，于2023年纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政...

body.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless military campaigns from the Azerbaijani army. Shot over the course of three eventful years, which culminated in the surrender of Nagorno-Karabakh’s separatist government in 2023 , Alexis Pazoumian’s haunting documentary harnesses the collective turmoil that dominated generations of Armenians. From the elderly to the very young, the community are united by an unwavering sense of pride, one that carries them through never-ending bloodshed and displacement. The film opens with the harrowing sight of a bombed-out school in the small village of Talish, where childlike innocence contrasts with wartime trauma. Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys, roam through the wreckage and scavenge for remains of past normalcy, like the scattered notebooks left behind by their former classmates. The threat of the enemy, however, is drilled into every aspect of their daily life. At school, they learn how to assemble guns, and at family gatherings, they join in songs that speak of heroic valour. That the children here – boys and girls – will grow up to become soldiers is a foregone conclusion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔 (Samvel) 和阿沃 (Avo) 这两个青春期男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地因残酷的冲突而受到创伤。 1991 年苏联解体后，纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发了长达数十年的领土争端，该地区主要是亚美尼亚人，与阿塞拜疆军队的无数军事行动进行了斗争。亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 这部令人难忘的纪录片历时三年多的时间拍摄，最终导致纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政府于 2023 年投降，讲述了统治几代亚美尼亚人的集体动乱。从老年人到年幼的孩子，社区都以一种坚定不移的自豪感团结在一起，这种自豪感使他们经历了永无休止的流血和流离失所。影片以塔利什小村庄一所被炸毁的学校的悲惨景象开始，孩子般的纯真与战时的创伤形成鲜明对比。萨姆维尔和阿沃是两个青春期前的男孩，他们在废墟中漫步，寻找过去常态的遗迹，比如他们以前的同学留下的散落的笔记本。然而，敌人的威胁渗透到他们日常生活的方方面面。在学校，他们学习如何组装枪支，在家庭聚会上，他们一起唱颂英雄勇气的歌曲。这里的孩子们——男孩和女孩——长大后成为士兵已成定局。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "The Black Garden" brings to light the profound impact of war on children, focusing on Samvel and Avo. Their young lives are shaped by conflict, a stark reminder of the voiceless who bear the brunt of adult disputes. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute."...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《黑花园》揭示了战争对儿童的深远影响，聚焦于萨姆维尔和阿沃。他们年幼的生活被冲突所塑造，这鲜明地提醒我们那些承受着成人争端重担的无声者。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能自辩的开口，为所有困苦者判定公正”。这部影片有力地证明了这一呼召，敦促我们铭记并倡导那些卷入全球冲突战火中的儿童。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Isaac Mizrahi Documentary ‘Unzipped’ Is the Ultimate ’90s Fashion Portrait — Watch the Trailer
title.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》是终极的90年代时尚肖像——观看预告片

summary.en: Douglas Reeve's 1995 documentary follows Mizrahi into his 1994 fall collection. Access was helped amply by the fact that they were dating at the time.
summary.zh: 道格拉斯·里夫1995年的纪录片跟随米兹拉希进入他1994年的秋季系列。由于当时他们正在约会，因此获得了充分的便利。

body.en:

Filmmaker Douglas Keeve’s 1995 documentary “ Unzipped ” follows fashion designer and eventual mogul Isaac Mizrahi, then the director’s boyfriend, into his fall 1994 collection. The ’90s-centric movie remains the ultimate portrait of New York’s high fashion world at the time, with guest appearances including Cindy Crawford, Naomi Campbell, Linda Evangelista, and Kate Moss. Plus, the film won the audience award at the 1995 Sundance Film Festival. Now, Janus Films is bringing the movie back to theaters courtesy of a new restoration. Watch the trailer below.

Here’s the synopsis courtesy of Janus Films: “Designer Isaac Mizrahi proved a force of nature on the road to his legendary fall 1994 collection, a career-defining triumph that was documented with an effervescent intimacy by Douglas Keeve, Mizrahi’s then-partner. Both a time capsule of the buoyant, raucous 1990s, when pop culture and high art became interchangeable, and a vérité-style, in-the-trenches report on the daily agonies and ecstasies of the creative process, this seminal artistic portrait — sumptuously shot by Ellen Kuras and Robert Leacock — transcends glitz and glamour to offer an extraordinary view of the charisma and force of will inherent to genius, as well as its personal costs.” Related Stories ‘Coyote vs. Acme,’ Viewed as Unreleasable by Warner Bros., Just Beat a Jacob Elordi and Ridley Scott Movie at the Box Office From Timothée Chalamet and Tom Cruise to Cynthia Erivo: It’s Time for Some Overdue Actors to Finally Win an Oscar

Charli XCX recently told Vogue : “Directed by Douglas Keeve, it follows Isaac Mizrahi as he gets ready for his New York Fashion Week collection. If you love fashion, you have to see this documentary. All the legends are there — Kate, Naomi, Christy — and even Galliano and Polly Mellen. But most importantly, the film perfectly captures the artist’s creative process: bursts of inspiration, self-doubt, vulnerability, and finally, triumph.”

Janus Films opens “Unzipped” on Friday, September 25 at Film Forum in New York City. Then, the film opens in Los Angeles at the Laemmle Royal and Glendale on Friday, October 9. A national rollout will follow. The Sundance Institute and UCLA Film & Television Archive digitally restored the film.

body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 电影制作人 Douglas Keeve 于 1995 年拍摄的纪录片《Unzipped》讲述了时装设计师、后来的大亨 Isaac Mizrahi（当时是导演的男友）走进他 1994 年秋季系列的故事。这部以 90 年代为中心的电影仍然是当时纽约高级时尚界的终极写照，客串包括辛迪·克劳馥、娜奥米·坎贝尔、琳达·伊万格丽斯塔和凯特·莫斯。此外，该片还获得了1995年圣丹斯电影节观众奖。现在，杰纳斯电影公司正在通过新的修复将这部电影带回影院。观看下面的预告片。 Janus Films 提供的概要如下：“设计师 Isaac Mizrahi 在 1994 年秋季系列的传奇之路上证明了自然的力量，这是一场定义职业生涯的胜利，Mizrahi 当时的合作伙伴 Douglas Keeve 热情洋溢地亲密记录了这一胜利。这既是一个充满活力、喧闹的 1990 年代的时间胶囊，当时流行文化和高雅艺术可以互换，也是一个这幅开创性的艺术肖像画由艾伦·库拉斯 (Ellen Kuras) 和罗伯特·利科克 (Robert Leacock) 精心拍摄，以真实风格、现场报道的方式记录了创作过程中日常的痛苦和狂喜，超越了浮华和魅力，以非凡的视角展示了天才固有的魅力和意志力，以及其个人成本。”相关故事雷德利·斯科特讲述从《塞尔玛与路易丝》到《狗明星》的爱情故事，用 11 个摄像机拍摄，以及为什么沉默是最好的音效《起义》认为需要罗宾汉，但农民的起义已经足够令人兴奋 Charli XCX 最近告诉《Vogue》：“这部由 Douglas Keeve 执导的影片讲述了 Isaac Mizrahi 为纽约时装周系列做准备的故事。如果你热爱时尚，你一定要看看这部纪录片。所有的传奇人物都在其中——Kate、Naomi、Christy——甚至 Galliano 和 Polly Mellen。但最重要的是，这部电影完美地捕捉了艺术家的创作过程：灵感的爆发、自我怀疑、脆弱，以及最后的胜利。” Janus Films 将于 9 月 25 日星期五在纽约电影论坛上放映《Unzipped》。然后，影片将于 10 月 9 日星期五在洛杉矶的莱姆勒皇家和格伦代尔上映。随后将在全国上映。圣丹斯学院和加州大学洛杉矶分校电影电视档案馆对这部电影进行了数字修复。 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商...

reflection.en: The documentary 'Unzipped' offers a glimpse into the intense dedication and creative labor behind Isaac Mizrahi's 1994 fall fashion collection. It showcases the passion and effort poured into bringing a vision to life, reminding us that all work, whether in design or any other field, can be offered as a service to God.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》让我们得以一窥艾萨克·米兹拉希1994年秋季时装系列背后倾注的专注和创造性劳动。它展示了将一个愿景变为现实所付出的热情和努力，提醒我们，所有工作，无论是在设计领域还是其他任何领域，都可以作为对雅伟的服事。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

body.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, is to receive its world premiere at the Venice film festival. The film, called NAZA, has been produced with Jim Wilson and executive produced by Jonathan Glazer, the team behind The Zone of Interest, and is the only documentary that will compete this year for Venice’s prestigious Golden Lion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导的电影，他们与巴塞尔·阿德拉 (Basel Adra) 和哈姆丹·巴拉尔 (Hamdan Ballal) 联合执导了《No Other Land》，调查了“以色列在战争期间有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民”。一部关于以色列在加沙的轰炸行动的新纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，将在威尼斯电影节上进行全球首映。这部名为《NAZA》的影片由吉姆·威尔逊 (Jim Wilson) 制作，并由《兴趣地带》(The Zone of Interest) 背后的团队乔纳森·格雷泽 (Jonathan Glazer) 担任监制，也是今年唯一一部角逐威尼斯著名金狮奖的纪录片。继续阅读...

In a world where many suffer in silence, such efforts to investigate and expose injustice embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. Yahweh's word reminds us of the...
reflection.zh: 这部名为《NAZA》的纪录片将在威尼斯电影节首映，旨在揭露加沙地带“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”。在一个许多人默默承受苦难的世界里，这种调查和揭露不公的努力，体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召。雅伟的话语提醒我们，为贫困者的权利发声并确保他们的故事被听见，是一项道德责任。

title.en: ‘We’re barely above porn’: why would a film-maker choose to make a deliberately bad ‘mockbuster’?
title.zh: “我们几乎比色情片好不了多少”：为什么电影制作人会选择制作一部故意拍得很烂的“恶搞电影”？

summary.en: Filmmaker Anthony Frith directed a low-budget "mockbuster" in six days for the studio behind Sharknado, then created a documentary about the experience. The article discusses the critical reception of his intentionally "bad" film.
summary.zh: 电影制作人安东尼·弗里斯为《鲨卷风》背后的工作室，仅用六天时间执导了一部低成本的“恶搞电影”，随后又制作了一部关于这次经历的纪录片。文章探讨了评论界对这部他有意为之的“烂片”的评价。

body.en: With a tiny budget and six days, Anthony Frith directed a film for the studio behind Sharknado – and then made Mockbuster, a documentary about the experience Directors don’t tend to appreciate having their films eviscerated by critics. And us critics, well practised in lobbing proverbial grenades from the safety of our pretentiously book-lined, Cahiers du Cinéma-strewn offices, don’t tend to look an artist in the eyes and tell them that their work sucks. This is, however, exactly what I do to the Australian film-maker Anthony Frith. I’ve even prepared a zinger for the occasion. “Your film is a lemon that’s been eaten by a turkey then dumped into a vat of curdled mayonnaise,” I say. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯 (Anthony Frith) 用有限的预算和六天的时间为《Sharknado》背后的工作室执导了一部电影，然后制作了《Mockbuster》，这是一部讲述导演们不喜欢自己的电影被评论家挖空的经历的纪录片。而我们的影评人，在我们自命不凡的书籍林立、电影手册散布的办公室里，熟练地投掷众所周知的手榴弹，不会倾向于直视艺术家的眼睛，告诉他们他们的作品很糟糕。然而，这正是我对澳大利亚电影制片人安东尼·弗里斯所做的。我什至还为这个场合准备了一杯辛格酒。 “你的电影是一个被火鸡吃掉的柠檬，然后倒入一桶凝结的蛋黄酱中，”我说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Anthony Frith's commitment to directing a film in just six days, even a "mockbuster" that he knew would face harsh criticism, highlights the intrinsic value of effort. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, suggesting that the dignity of our labor comes from our intention and dedication, not solely from the outcome or...
reflection.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯仅用六天时间执导一部电影，即便他知道这部“恶搞电影”会面临严厉批评，他的这种投入精神突显了努力的内在价值。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这表明我们劳动的尊严源于我们的意图和奉献，而不仅仅是结果或评论界的赞誉。这种视角能将最非传统或看似“糟糕”的项目，转化为有意义的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: ‘Possible Love’ Trailer: ‘Burning’ Director Lee Chang-dong Returns with a Story of Documentary Filmmaking Gone Awry
title.zh: 《可能的爱》预告片：《燃烧》导演李沧东携纪录片失控故事回归

summary.en: Netflix is set to release "Possible Love," a new film from acclaimed director Lee Chang-dong, in theaters on Friday, October 23, following its Venice premiere. The film is described as a story of documentary filmmaking gone awry, continuing the director's tradition of capturing human despair.
summary.zh: 备受赞誉的导演李沧东的新片《可能的爱》将于10月23日星期五在威尼斯首映后在影院上映。这部电影被描述为一个纪录片制作失控的故事，延续了导演捕捉人类绝望的传统。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

A new film from Lee Chang-dong is always a major event on the cinema calendar . The South Korean auteur has directed six movies since 1997, each one demonstrating his literary sensibilities and keen eye for capturing human despair. And ever since his seventh film, the upcoming “ Possible Love ,” was announced, cinephiles have been preparing to have their hearts broken.

“Possible Love” is loosely based on a segment of Krzysztof Kieślowski’s “Dekalog,” making it the second film of 2026 to take inspiration from the ten-part film that explored modern interpretations of the Ten Commandments. (The first was Asghar Farhadi’s “Parallel Lives,” which premiered to Cannes to mixed reviews.) The film explores the secrets hidden beneath marriages, following two married couples whose lives intersect while filming a documentary together. Related Stories Indie Films Should Tour Like a Band ‘Idiots’ Review: Macon Blair Merges ‘The Last Detail’ with ‘Road Trip’ in a Wildly Uneven Comedy That Fails to Find Its Own Lane

“Possible Love” stars Jeon Do-yeon, Sul Kyung-gu, Zo In-sung, and Cho Yeo-jeong. Lee co-wrote the film with Oh Jung-mi.

An official synopsis for the film reads: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

“Possible Love” will have its world premiere at the 2026 Venice International Film Festival , where it will compete for the Golden Lion. It will go on to screen at the Toronto International Film Festival before Netflix releases it domestically in October. The film has been selected as South Korea’s official submission to the Best International Feature category at the 99th Academy Awards.

While Lee has not released a film in eight years, he has remained active in the world of literature and continued to promote repertory screenings of his work. In a 2024 interview with IndieWire , he reflected on the thematic threads connecting his entire filmography.

“Everyone unexpectedly faces pain and suffers from hopelessness and failure,” Lee said. “That is life. The world unjustly suppresses and gives pain to an individual. The problem is how you cope with the pain. Thus, the struggle is more important than the pain itself. Through the struggle, humans find the purpose of life and find salvation. Protagonists in tragedies are those types of people. I tried to...
body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 李沧东的新片永远是电影日历上的一件大事。这位韩国导演自 1997 年以来执导了六部电影，每一部电影都展示了他的文学敏感性和捕捉人类绝望的敏锐眼光。自从他的第七部电影即将上映的《可能的爱》宣布以来，影迷们就已经做好了心碎的准备。 《可能的爱》大致改编自克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基的《十诫》中的一个片段，这使其成为 2026 年第二部从这部探讨十诫现代诠释的十集电影中汲取灵感的电影。 （第一部是阿斯加尔·法哈迪的《平行生活》，该片在戛纳首映，评价褒贬不一。）这部电影探讨了隐藏在婚姻之下的秘密，讲述了两对已婚夫妇在一起拍摄纪录片时生活交叉的故事。相关故事独立电影应该像乐队一样巡回演出《白痴》评论：梅肯·布莱尔将《最后的细节》与《公路旅行》融合在一部极其不平衡的喜剧中，但未能找到自己的道路 《可能的爱情》由全度妍、薛景求、赵寅成、曹汝贞主演。李与吴正美共同编剧了这部电影。 影片的官方剧情简介如下：一名下岗工人和他的妻子与一名纪录片制片人和她的配偶相遇，并面对他们隐藏的欲望。 《可能的爱情》将在2026年威尼斯国际电影节全球首映，角逐金狮奖。该片将在多伦多国际电影节上放映，然后 Netflix 将于 10 月份在国内上映。该片已被选为韩国正式提交的第 99 届奥斯卡金像奖最佳国际影片奖。 尽管李已经八年没有发行电影了，但他仍然活跃在文学界，并继续推动其作品的剧目放映。在 2024 年接受 IndieWire 采访时，他反思了连接他整个电影作品的主题线索。 “每个人都会意外地面临痛苦、绝望和失败，”李说。 “这就是生活。这个世界不公正地压制和给予一个人痛苦。问题是你如何应对痛苦。因此，斗争比痛苦本身更重要。通过斗争，人类找到了生活的目的，找到了救赎。悲剧的主角就是这样的人。我试图……

reflection.en: Director Lee Chang-dong's new film, "Possible Love," promises to delve into "human despair" and leave audiences "brokenhearted" as it explores documentary filmmaking gone awry. In a world where stories often highlight profound suffering, Psalm 34:18 reminds us that Yahweh is near to those who are brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit. This offers a...
reflection.zh: 导演李沧东的新片《可能的爱》承诺将深入探讨“人类的绝望”，并随着纪录片制作的失控而让观众“心碎”。在一个故事常常凸显深重苦难的世界里，诗篇34:18提醒我们，雅伟亲近伤心的人，拯救灵里破碎的人。这提供了一种安静的盼望，即使面对生命中最艰难的现实，神圣的同在也与那些受苦的人同在。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: How the mob took Hollywood: the story of organized crime and the movies
title.zh: 黑帮如何掌控好莱坞：有组织犯罪与电影的故事

summary.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series,...
summary.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮掌控电影业》回顾了犯罪分子如何渗透电影业。该三部曲纪录片的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森称：“从好莱坞创立之初，有组织犯罪就已存在。”

body.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series, Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies. Organized crime’s connection to the film industry actually predates Tinseltown, being present for the foundation of the medium itself, when inventor Thomas Edison sicced his hired goons on competitors in an attempt to maintain total control over early motion picture technology. As covered in Hollywood Crime Story, this resulted in said competitors – mostly Jewish businessmen from the east coast – fleeing westward and establishing the town and studio system that would become synonymous with movies as we know them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》回顾了犯罪分子如何潜入电影行业“从好莱坞的根基开始，有组织的犯罪就在那里。”新的三集纪录片系列《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森如是说。有组织犯罪与电影业的联系实际上早于好莱坞，当时发明家托马斯·爱迪生（Thomas Edison）为了保持对早期电影技术的完全控制，而雇佣了暴徒来对付竞争对手，这一点就为电影本身奠定了基础。正如《好莱坞犯罪故事》中所报道的那样，这导致上述竞争对手（主要是来自东海岸的犹太商人）向西逃亡，并建立了城镇和制片厂系统，该系统将成为我们所知的电影的代名词。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "Hollywood Crime Story" reveals how organized crime, driven by the pursuit of wealth and power, embedded itself in the film industry from its very beginning, even with figures like Thomas Edison using "hired goons." This historical account reminds us that the love of money can indeed be a root of all kinds of evil, corrupting even creative...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事》揭示了有组织犯罪如何从电影业的早期，甚至从托马斯·爱迪生使用“雇佣打手”开始，就因对财富和权力的追求而渗透其中。这个历史记载提醒我们，贪爱钱财确实是万恶之根，它能腐蚀社会中富有创造力和影响力的领域。这凸显了在面对非法利益的诱惑时，保持正直所需的持续警惕。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Hanging By a Wire review – cable car rescue documentary dangles viewers on the edge of disaster
title.zh: 《悬挂在钢丝上》影评——缆车救援纪录片让观众悬在灾难边缘

summary.en: The documentary "Hanging By a Wire" recounts the tense survival story of eight people trapped in a cable car above a chasm in Pakistan, featuring their extraordinary fate and daring rescue.
summary.zh: 纪录片《悬挂在钢丝上》讲述了八名被困在巴基斯坦峡谷上方缆车中的人们惊心动魄的生存故事，展现了他们非凡的命运和大胆的救援行动。

body.en: The extraordinary fate of eight people trapped above a chasm in Pakistan makes for a tense, skilfully assembled survival story with unexpected flashes of comedy Survival documentaries are a weird little genre of nonfiction film-making that recount the stories of accidents and natural catastrophes – and more often than not, the daring rescues of people caught up in them. Eyewitnesses and the loved ones of those endangered are top of the interview list, to keep the sense of danger and emotional stakes at the top of everyone’s mind. Survivors can also have their say, and more adventurous film-makers might care to recreate the action with actors or the actual survivors themselves. This account of how eight people – six teenage boys and two adult men – were left suspended over a chasm in northern Pakistan in 2023, when a wire on the cable car they were travelling on broke, is a pretty conventional example of the form. For obvious reasons, no one tries to recreate the situation, but since it was quite recent there is no shortage of news footage and amateur clips to fill out the particulars. The downside of doing a story that’s so recent is that some of the audience may remember what happened anyway, but still there’s plenty of nail-nibbling suspense here, and sequences that will give anyone with acrophobia the heebie jeebies – especially the drone shots that zoom close on the terrified faces of those trapped inside the dangling car. Continue reading...
body.zh: 八个人被困在巴基斯坦的深渊上，他们的非凡命运造就了一个紧张而巧妙的生存故事，其中有意想不到的喜剧闪现。生存纪录片是一种奇怪的非虚构电影制作类型，讲述了事故和自然灾害的故事，而且往往讲述了被困人员的勇敢营救。目击者和那些濒临灭绝的人的亲人是采访的首要对象，以便让每个人都牢记危险感和情感风险。幸存者也可以发表意见，更具冒险精神的电影制作人可能会愿意与演员或真正的幸存者本人一起重现动作。这个故事描述了 2023 年，八个人（六名十几岁的男孩和两名成年男子）在巴基斯坦北部的一个峡谷上悬吊着，当时他们乘坐的缆车上的电线断裂了，这是这种形式的一个非常传统的例子。出于显而易见的原因，没有人试图重现这种情况，但由于这是最近发生的事情，因此不乏新闻片段和业余剪辑来填充细节。制作一个最近发生的故事的缺点是，一些观众可能会记得发生了什么，但这里仍然有很多令人紧张的悬念，以及会让任何有恐高症的人感到惊慌的序列——尤其是无人机拍摄的镜头，近距离拍摄那些被困在悬空的汽车里的人惊恐的面孔。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The harrowing ordeal of eight individuals suspended above a chasm in a Pakistani cable car reminds us of how vulnerable life can be when disaster strikes. In such moments of extreme peril, the human spirit yearns for a refuge and strength beyond its own, a help that is truly ever-present. Yahweh is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble,...
reflection.zh: 八名乘客被困在巴基斯坦峡谷上方的缆车中，这惊心动魄的经历提醒我们，当灾难降临时，生命是多么脆弱。在如此极度的危险时刻，人的心灵渴望超越自身的力量，寻求一个真正无处不在的避难所和力量。雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助，当面对压倒性的挑战时，祂赐予我们安慰和支持。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。
